cin_ch01_intro_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch01_intro_s0.ogg.text: Three hundred years ago, the Azure Cloud and the Verdant Lotus sealed a monster beneath the earth, and the world forgot.

cin_ch01_intro_s1.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch01_intro_s1.ogg.text: Only the Azure Cloud Sect remembers. It keeps its watch on this mountain, above the sea of clouds.

cin_ch01_intro_s2.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch01_intro_s2.ogg.text: Every spring, its gate opens to those with the talent and stubbornness to climb nine thousand steps.

cin_ch01_intro_s3.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch01_intro_s3.ogg.text: This spring, an orphan with nothing but a jade pendant reached the top.

cin_ch01_intro_s4_f.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch01_intro_s4_f.ogg.text: The Azure Cloud Sect. I made it, Mother.

cin_ch01_intro_s4_m.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch01_intro_s4_m.ogg.text: The Azure Cloud Sect. I made it, Mother.

cin_ch02_intro_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch02_intro_s0.ogg.text: The teleport array flares, and the mountain is gone. In its place, bamboo, green and endless, whispering in the wind.

cin_ch02_intro_s1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
cin_ch02_intro_s1.ogg.text: First mission outside the walls! Don't wander off, don't eat red mushrooms, and don't pet anything with more than four eyes.

cin_ch02_intro_s2.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch02_intro_s2.ogg.text: The Whispering Bamboo Forest. Spirit herbs grow here, and spirit wolves hunt here. Usually they leave cultivators alone.

cin_ch03_intro_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch03_intro_s0.ogg.text: Qingshi Town. Rice fields, a river, a market, and a temple where the kindly keeper buries the dead.

cin_ch03_intro_s1.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch03_intro_s1.ogg.text: Every new moon, somebody vanishes. Every morning after, the town pretends not to notice.

cin_ch03_intro_s3.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
cin_ch03_intro_s3.ogg.text: Visitors from the mountain! How wonderful. May the ancestors bless your journey, young immortals.

cin_ch03_intro_s4_f.ogg.speaker: senior_han
cin_ch03_intro_s4_f.ogg.text: Eyes open, Junior Sister. Towns that smile this hard are usually hiding something.

cin_ch03_intro_s4_m.ogg.speaker: senior_han
cin_ch03_intro_s4_m.ogg.text: Eyes open, Junior Brother. Towns that smile this hard are usually hiding something.

cin_ch03_reveal_s0.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
cin_ch03_reveal_s0.ogg.text: Clever children. Too clever. Keeper Hong was such a comfortable face. I wore it for eleven years.

cin_ch03_reveal_s1.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch03_reveal_s1.ogg.text: The old man's skin splits like a husk. Beneath it: black and crimson robes, and eyes the colour of blood.

cin_ch03_reveal_s2.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
cin_ch03_reveal_s2.ogg.text: Deacon Hong Lie of the Blood Moon. The Patriarch stirs, lotus-bearer, and he dreams of you.

cin_ch03_reveal_s3_f.ogg.speaker: senior_han
cin_ch03_reveal_s3_f.ogg.text: Acolytes in the alley! Su Yue, he's running for the graves!

cin_ch03_reveal_s3_m.ogg.speaker: senior_han
cin_ch03_reveal_s3_m.ogg.text: Acolytes in the alley! Lin Feng, he's running for the graves!

cin_ch04_intro_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch04_intro_s0.ogg.text: North of the wolf dens, where even the bamboo grows quiet, the forest hides something older than any sect alive.

cin_ch04_intro_s1.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch04_intro_s1.ogg.text: The Verdant Lotus Sect. Once it stood beside the Azure Cloud as an equal. Now its name is a footnote.

cin_ch04_intro_s2.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch04_intro_s2.ogg.text: Its ruins keep their secrets well. But stones cannot be cut out of a book.

cin_ch04_intro_s3.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
cin_ch04_intro_s3.ogg.text: So. The lotus comes home at last. I had hoped to be dead before it did.

cin_ch04_lotus_s0.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
cin_ch04_lotus_s0.ogg.text: Three hundred years ago the Blood Moon Patriarch drowned three kingdoms in blood, reaching for the heavens.

cin_ch04_lotus_s1.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
cin_ch04_lotus_s1.ogg.text: Our sect master and your founder bound him beneath the Abyss. The seal needed two keys, and a price.

cin_ch04_lotus_s2.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
cin_ch04_lotus_s2.ogg.text: The Verdant Lotus paid it. Every elder gave their life to the seal. The Patriarch's servants hunted the rest of us.

cin_ch04_lotus_s3.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
cin_ch04_lotus_s3.ogg.text: One disciple fled with the Lotus Key and a baby girl. Her line hid among mortals for three centuries.

cin_ch04_lotus_s4.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
cin_ch04_lotus_s4.ogg.text: Your mother's pendant, child, is that key. And you are the last of the Verdant Lotus.

cin_ch05_intro_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch05_intro_s0.ogg.text: Once every three years, the Azure Cloud Sect raises its banners for the Inner Sect Tournament.

cin_ch05_intro_s1.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
cin_ch05_intro_s1.ogg.text: Disciples of the Azure Cloud! Fight hard, fight fair, and whoever breaks the formation tiles pays for them.

cin_ch05_intro_s2.ogg.speaker: master_yun
cin_ch05_intro_s2.ogg.text: The victor will stand beside me and learn the secrets of the Azure Eye. Show heaven what this sect is made of.

cin_ch05_intro_s3.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch05_intro_s3.ogg.text: In the crowd, not everyone is watching the fighters.

cin_ch05_intro_s4_f.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch05_intro_s4_f.ogg.text: Nine to one odds. Lu Ping had better not be wrong about me.

cin_ch05_intro_s4_m.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch05_intro_s4_m.ogg.text: Nine to one odds. Lu Ping had better not be wrong about me.

cin_ch05_traitor_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch05_traitor_s0.ogg.text: The pagoda doors hang open. Scrolls lie scattered like fallen leaves. And at the heart of the mess stands the Law Hall Elder.

cin_ch05_traitor_s1.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
cin_ch05_traitor_s1.ogg.text: You were supposed to be watching the final, disciple. Everyone was supposed to be watching the final.

cin_ch05_traitor_s2_f.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch05_traitor_s2_f.ogg.text: Elder Gu. The token, the missions, the pages, the pills. It was you. All of it.

cin_ch05_traitor_s2_m.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch05_traitor_s2_m.ogg.text: Elder Gu. The token, the missions, the pages, the pills. It was you. All of it.

cin_ch05_traitor_s3.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
cin_ch05_traitor_s3.ogg.text: I did what a father does. Heaven took my daughter. The Blood Moon offered her back. You would have done the same.

cin_ch05_traitor_s4.ogg.speaker: master_yun
cin_ch05_traitor_s4.ogg.text: Gu Hanshan! Put down the diagram and kneel, or I will strike you down where you stand.

cin_ch05_traitor_s5.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
cin_ch05_traitor_s5.ogg.text: Forty years of loyalty, Sect Master, and you never once asked why I stopped smiling. Kill them.

cin_ch06_altar_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch06_altar_s0.ogg.text: Blood from the broken obelisks still trickles along the channels, up the dais, into the great altar.

cin_ch06_altar_s1.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
cin_ch06_altar_s1.ogg.text: The diagram is delivered, Patriarch. The Azure Eye's design is in your hands. Now keep your promise. Give me my Lan.

cin_ch06_altar_s2.ogg.speaker: patriarch_xue
cin_ch06_altar_s2.ogg.text: Patience, loyal Gu. When I walk again, you will have everything you deserve. Everything.

cin_ch06_altar_s3.ogg.speaker: crimson_xuemei
cin_ch06_altar_s3.ogg.text: Master, the lotus-bearer is here. The little lamb has come to the altar all by itself.

cin_ch06_altar_s4.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
cin_ch06_altar_s4.ogg.text: Disciple. You should not have come. Xue Mei, keep it alive. The Patriarch needs the body intact.

cin_ch06_intro_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch06_intro_s0.ogg.text: The Blood Moon Abyss. A wound in the earth, three hundred years deep, where the moon is always red.

cin_ch06_intro_s1.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch06_intro_s1.ogg.text: Once a kingdom stood here. Its people were the Patriarch's first harvest.

cin_ch06_intro_s2.ogg.speaker: senior_han
cin_ch06_intro_s2.ogg.text: It stinks of old blood. Stay behind me. No. Stay beside me. Where I can see you.

cin_ch06_intro_s3.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
cin_ch06_intro_s3.ogg.text: Step where I step. Breathe when I breathe. Welcome to the place I was born.

cin_ch07_intro_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch07_intro_s0.ogg.text: The Blood Moon comes to Qingshi on the third night: demon cultivators, blood-fed wolves, and Iron-Fang's bandits beside them.

cin_ch07_intro_s1.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch07_intro_s1.ogg.text: Their banners rise on the graveyard hill, above empty graves the town has only just refilled.

cin_ch07_intro_s2.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
cin_ch07_intro_s2.ogg.text: I count four hundred. Maybe five. I'd count better if they stood still.

cin_ch07_intro_s3.ogg.speaker: magistrate_zhou
cin_ch07_intro_s3.ogg.text: People of Qingshi! Last time, we hid. We locked our doors and let a monster feed on our children. Not this time!

cin_ch07_intro_s4_f.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch07_intro_s4_f.ogg.text: Then we hold. Every street, every house, every wall. Not one more grave.

cin_ch07_intro_s4_m.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch07_intro_s4_m.ogg.text: Then we hold. Every street, every house, every wall. Not one more grave.

cin_ch08_intro_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch08_intro_s0.ogg.text: Once every sixty years the clouds part, and the Celestial Sky Isles drift down within reach of mortal arrays.

cin_ch08_intro_s1.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch08_intro_s1.ogg.text: Here, where immortals once lived, star iron falls like rain and thunder grows in the rocks like crystal flowers.

cin_ch08_intro_s2_f.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch08_intro_s2_f.ogg.text: Everything is floating. The whole world is floating.

cin_ch08_intro_s2_m.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch08_intro_s2_m.ogg.text: Everything is floating. The whole world is floating.

cin_ch08_intro_s3.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
cin_ch08_intro_s3.ogg.text: Please stop saying floating. Say resting on very tall air.

cin_ch08_intro_s4.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch08_intro_s4.ogg.text: And at the highest point, the summit where heavenly tribulation strikes, waits the stair that climbs to heaven.

cin_ch09_intro_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch09_intro_s0.ogg.text: The Great Azure Formation stands complete: star iron pillars, thunder crystals, a web of ten thousand runes.

cin_ch09_intro_s1.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
cin_ch09_intro_s1.ogg.text: Outer ring. Seventh branch. This rune turns outward. It should turn inward. Why would it turn outward?

cin_ch09_intro_s2.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
cin_ch09_intro_s2.ogg.text: The Law Hall archive. Thirty years of Gu's hands on every page. Oh, you fool. You poor, grieving fool.

cin_ch09_intro_s3.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch09_intro_s3.ogg.text: Above the sea of clouds, the moon rises, and for the first time in three hundred years, it rises red.

cin_ch09_mirror_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch09_mirror_s0.ogg.text: The water does not ripple. Your reflection rises from it, dripping darkness, wearing your face like a mask.

cin_ch09_mirror_s1_f.ogg.speaker: heart_demon
cin_ch09_mirror_s1_f.ogg.text: Hello, Su Yue. Don't you recognise me? I'm every time you were afraid, and pretended you weren't.

cin_ch09_mirror_s1_m.ogg.speaker: heart_demon
cin_ch09_mirror_s1_m.ogg.text: Hello, Lin Feng. Don't you recognise me? I'm every time you were afraid, and pretended you weren't.

cin_ch09_mirror_s2_f.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch09_mirror_s2_f.ogg.text: I know what you are. A heart demon. You feed on doubt.

cin_ch09_mirror_s2_m.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch09_mirror_s2_m.ogg.text: I know what you are. A heart demon. You feed on doubt.

cin_ch09_mirror_s3.ogg.speaker: heart_demon
cin_ch09_mirror_s3.ogg.text: Then I'll never go hungry. Let me in. I'll carry the key for you. Isn't it heavy? Isn't it so very heavy?

cin_ch09_sacrifice_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch09_sacrifice_s0.ogg.text: The Great Azure Formation roars like a furnace, blood-red, pulling the mountain's qi downward into the dark.

cin_ch09_sacrifice_s1.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
cin_ch09_sacrifice_s1.ogg.text: Stay back, all of you! Seven runes. I can turn seven runes. I just need something big enough to push them.

cin_ch09_sacrifice_s2_f.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch09_sacrifice_s2_f.ogg.text: Elder Mo, no! Let me help, I have the Lotus Key!

cin_ch09_sacrifice_s2_m.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch09_sacrifice_s2_m.ogg.text: Elder Mo, no! Let me help, I have the Lotus Key!

cin_ch09_sacrifice_s3_f.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
cin_ch09_sacrifice_s3_f.ogg.text: The key is for tomorrow, Junior Sister. Tonight is for old men. Back straight, now. Crooked spine, crooked meridian.

cin_ch09_sacrifice_s3_m.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
cin_ch09_sacrifice_s3_m.ogg.text: The key is for tomorrow, Junior Brother. Tonight is for old men. Back straight, now. Crooked spine, crooked meridian.

cin_ch09_sacrifice_s4.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch09_sacrifice_s4.ogg.text: Elder Mo Changfeng burns his core, his soul and seventy years of cultivation in a single breath. The red light turns blue.

cin_ch09_sacrifice_s5.ogg.speaker: master_yun
cin_ch09_sacrifice_s5.ogg.text: Mo Changfeng. Elder of the Outer Court. You stubborn, stubborn old man.

cin_ch10_ascension_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_ascension_s0.ogg.text: The Ascension Stair opens, step by step, a road of light from the summit into the clouds.

cin_ch10_ascension_s1.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_ascension_s1.ogg.text: Below, the Sect Master bows. Han Xue raises her sword. Zhao Kang shouts something rude, and wipes his eyes.

cin_ch10_ascension_s2_f.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch10_ascension_s2_f.ogg.text: I'll come back. Maybe not soon. But I'll come back.

cin_ch10_ascension_s2_m.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch10_ascension_s2_m.ogg.text: I'll come back. Maybe not soon. But I'll come back.

cin_ch10_ascension_s3_f.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_ascension_s3_f.ogg.text: And Su Yue, last of the Verdant Lotus, disciple of the Azure Cloud, climbs into the heavens.

cin_ch10_ascension_s3_m.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_ascension_s3_m.ogg.text: And Lin Feng, last of the Verdant Lotus, disciple of the Azure Cloud, climbs into the heavens.

cin_ch10_epilogue_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_epilogue_s0.ogg.text: The Great Azure Formation holds. The Blood Moon Abyss is sealed, and this time, the seal will last ten thousand years.

cin_ch10_epilogue_s1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
cin_ch10_epilogue_s1.ogg.text: Lead with your feet, not your elbows! And whoever breaks the puppet buys lunch. For Elder Mo!

cin_ch10_epilogue_s2.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_epilogue_s2.ogg.text: An old hermit teaches the Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra in the pagoda. Every morning, more students come.

cin_ch10_epilogue_s3.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_epilogue_s3.ogg.text: Xiao Man grows herbs. She only drops some of them. Her brother writes every week.

cin_ch10_epilogue_s4.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_epilogue_s4.ogg.text: And on clear nights, above the sea of clouds, one star blinks twice, as if someone up there were waving.

cin_ch10_intro_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_intro_s0.ogg.text: Under the last blood moon, the Azure Cloud Sect goes to war: elders, disciples, a bandit's army and a traitor in chains.

cin_ch10_intro_s1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
cin_ch10_intro_s1.ogg.text: Three hundred years ago our founders stood here and did not finish the job. We will finish it.

cin_ch10_intro_s2.ogg.speaker: master_yun
cin_ch10_intro_s2.ogg.text: For Mo Changfeng. For the Verdant Lotus. For everyone this Abyss has swallowed. Azure Cloud, advance!

cin_ch10_intro_s3.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_intro_s3.ogg.text: Beyond the black gate, on a throne of fused bone, something that was once a man opens its eyes.

cin_ch10_patriarch_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_patriarch_s0.ogg.text: Xue Wuji, Patriarch of the Blood Moon. Three kingdoms drowned for his ambition. Three centuries of hunger in the dark.

cin_ch10_patriarch_s1.ogg.speaker: patriarch_xue
cin_ch10_patriarch_s1.ogg.text: The last of the Verdant Lotus. Do you know how long I have waited for you? Your great-grandmother's great-grandmother escaped me.

cin_ch10_patriarch_s2_f.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch10_patriarch_s2_f.ogg.text: You broke Gu with grief. You tried to break me with fear. It didn't work.

cin_ch10_patriarch_s2_m.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch10_patriarch_s2_m.ogg.text: You broke Gu with grief. You tried to break me with fear. It didn't work.

cin_ch10_patriarch_s3.ogg.speaker: patriarch_xue
cin_ch10_patriarch_s3.ogg.text: Then I will break you the old way. With my hands. Come, little lotus. Show me my new body.

cin_ch10_tribulation_s0.ogg.speaker: narrator
cin_ch10_tribulation_s0.ogg.text: Above the summit, the clouds spiral into a black eye nine miles wide. Heaven has seen you. Heaven is coming.

cin_ch10_tribulation_s1_f.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch10_tribulation_s1_f.ogg.text: Nine bolts. Elder Bai said nobody knows what the ninth one is. Wonderful.

cin_ch10_tribulation_s1_m.ogg.speaker: player
cin_ch10_tribulation_s1_m.ogg.text: Nine bolts. Elder Bai said nobody knows what the ninth one is. Wonderful.

cin_ch10_tribulation_s2.ogg.speaker: patriarch_xue
cin_ch10_tribulation_s2.ogg.text: I know, little lotus. The ninth is the heart. And I will be waiting inside it.

q001_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q001_o1_l0.ogg.text: Halt! State your name and business. And please don't faint, the last three candidates fainted on my boots.

q001_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q001_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: I am Su Yue. I have a letter of recommendation from the village of Willow Creek.

q001_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q001_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: I am Lin Feng. I have a letter of recommendation from the village of Willow Creek.

q001_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q001_o1_l2.ogg.text: A letter! Very fancy. Mostly they bring mud and hope. Go on through, Elder Mo is at the hall steps.

q001_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q001_o1_l3.ogg.text: Tip from your future Senior Brother: bow low, speak little, and never, ever mention his beard.

q001_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q001_o2_l0.ogg.text: The main hall rises above a sea of white stone, its double eaves curling like a crane about to fly.

q001_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q001_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: Nine thousand steps. My legs are crying. But I'm here.

q001_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q001_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: Nine thousand steps. My legs are crying. But I'm here.

q001_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q001_o3_l0.ogg.text: Another one. Let me guess. Orphan, no family, dreams of flying on a sword.

q001_o3_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q001_o3_l1_f.ogg.text: Orphan, yes. The sword can wait. I want to become strong enough to protect people.

q001_o3_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q001_o3_l1_m.ogg.text: Orphan, yes. The sword can wait. I want to become strong enough to protect people.

q001_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q001_o3_l2.ogg.text: Hmph. Better answer than most. What is that jade at your belt?

q001_o3_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q001_o3_l3_f.ogg.text: My mother's pendant. It's all I have of her.

q001_o3_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q001_o3_l3_m.ogg.text: My mother's pendant. It's all I have of her.

q001_o3_l4_f.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q001_o3_l4_f.ogg.text: Keep it close, then. Welcome to the Azure Cloud, Junior Sister. Tomorrow you learn how little you know.

q001_o3_l4_m.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q001_o3_l4_m.ogg.text: Keep it close, then. Welcome to the Azure Cloud, Junior Brother. Tomorrow you learn how little you know.

q002_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q002_o0_l0.ogg.text: You are the new one. I am Gu Hanshan of the Law Hall. I enforce the precepts. All of them.

q002_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q002_o0_l1.ogg.text: The Nine Precepts are carved on the stele inside the gate. Learn them. Ignorance is not a defence.

q002_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q002_o0_l2.ogg.text: And that pendant. Jade draws envy, and envy draws blood. Keep it hidden, disciple.

q002_o0_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q002_o0_l3_f.ogg.text: Yes, Elder. I will be careful.

q002_o0_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q002_o0_l3_m.ogg.text: Yes, Elder. I will be careful.

q002_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q002_o1_l0.ogg.text: Do not harm a fellow disciple. Do not steal the sect's treasures. Do not consort with demonic cultivators.

q002_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q002_o1_l1.ogg.text: The last precept is worn smooth by generations of fingers. It reads: guard the seal, even unto death.

q002_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q002_o2_l0.ogg.text: Incense smoke curls past the hall doors. Inside, the founder's tablet gleams, and beside it a lotus, carved in faded green.

q002_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: steward_qian
q002_o3_l0.ogg.text: Allowance, allowance. Everyone wants their allowance. Name? Ah, the new one. Three spirit stones.

q002_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: steward_qian
q002_o3_l1.ogg.text: Minus one for your robe. Minus one for the robe's laundering. That leaves... hmm, one. Congratulations.

q002_o3_l3.ogg.speaker: steward_qian
q002_o3_l3.ogg.text: Then it was a very efficient laundering. Next!

q003_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q003_o0_l0.ogg.text: Ah, fresh meat! No offence. I call everyone fresh meat. I'm usually hungry.

q003_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q003_o0_l1.ogg.text: Wei Tong, senior outer disciple. I teach the basics: stance, strike, and not falling over.

q003_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q003_o0_l2.ogg.text: The training puppets are enchanted to fight back. Gently. Mostly gently. Break three and we'll talk.

q003_o1_l0_f.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q003_o1_l0_f.ogg.text: Lead with your feet, not your elbows! Your sword follows your body, Junior Sister!

q003_o1_l0_m.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q003_o1_l0_m.ogg.text: Lead with your feet, not your elbows! Your sword follows your body, Junior Brother!

q003_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q003_o2_l0.ogg.text: Oh, did I forget to mention? They come back in pairs after the first set. Surprise!

q003_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q003_o3_l0.ogg.text: Three puppets! Elder Mo owes me a bun. I bet him you'd manage two.

q003_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q003_o3_l2.ogg.text: I bet on everyone. It keeps life interesting. Here, take this. Real fighters need real rice.

q004_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q004_o0_l0.ogg.text: So you're the village brat with the letter. The Zhao clan paid a thousand spirit stones for my place here.

q004_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q004_o0_l1.ogg.text: And you walked in with a scrap of paper and a trinket. The sect has lowered its standards.

q004_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q004_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: The steps were the same height for both of us.

q004_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q004_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: The steps were the same height for both of us.

q004_o0_l3.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q004_o0_l3.ogg.text: Clever mouth. My attendants will test it. Training ground. Now.

q004_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q004_o1_l0.ogg.text: Don't damage their faces. They're expensive.

q004_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q004_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: I'll try to be gentle. Mostly gently.

q004_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q004_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: I'll try to be gentle. Mostly gently.

q004_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q004_o2_l0.ogg.text: You slapped the Zhao clan's face on your second day? Ha! I'll have to buy you dumplings.

q004_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q004_o2_l1.ogg.text: Careful, though. Zhao Kang's not wicked, just raised on gold and flattery. That kind of pride bruises easily.

q004_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q004_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Then maybe it should bruise a little.

q004_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q004_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Then maybe it should bruise a little.

q005_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q005_o0_l0.ogg.text: Elder Mo asked me to teach you to breathe. Apparently you've been doing it wrong your whole life.

q005_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q005_o0_l1.ogg.text: Qi flows everywhere. In the wind, the water, the stone. Cultivators learn to draw it in and keep it.

q005_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q005_o0_l2.ogg.text: Go to the stone bridge. Water and air meet there, and the qi is gentle. Sit. Listen.

q005_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q005_o1_l0.ogg.text: Breathe in. The cool of the pond, the scent of lotus. Something bright stirs beneath your navel.

q005_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q005_o1_l1.ogg.text: Your pendant grows warm against your chest, as if it too were breathing.

q005_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q005_o2_l0.ogg.text: You felt it? The first time, most people only feel their legs going numb.

q005_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q005_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: It was like a spark. And my pendant grew warm.

q005_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q005_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: It was like a spark. And my pendant grew warm.

q005_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q005_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Warm? Hm. Jade doesn't usually do that. Tell no one but the elders, Junior Sister.

q005_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q005_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Warm? Hm. Jade doesn't usually do that. Tell no one but the elders, Junior Brother.

q006_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q006_o0_l0.ogg.text: You're the new one Han Xue mentioned. Good. My hands are full and my apprentice's hands are... enthusiastic.

q006_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q006_o0_l1.ogg.text: Gather five spirit herbs from the terraces. Pull them at the root, gently, the way you'd lift a sleeping child.

q006_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q006_o2_l0.ogg.text: Oh no, oh no. Elder Hua's herbs went in the pond. The carp ate two. I think they're enlightened now.

q006_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q006_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: Don't worry, I picked extra. Here.

q006_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q006_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: Don't worry, I picked extra. Here.

q006_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q006_o2_l2.ogg.text: You're a lifesaver! I'm Xiao Man. My brother Xiao Shi is an outer disciple too, but he's home in Qingshi.

q006_o2_l3.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q006_o2_l3.ogg.text: He promised to write every week. It's been a month. He's probably too busy eating Mother's cooking.

q006_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q006_o3_l0.ogg.text: Five herbs, roots intact, and my apprentice still dry. You have a careful hand.

q006_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q006_o3_l1.ogg.text: Careful hands make good alchemists and better friends. Take this pill. It will ease your meridians.

q007_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q007_o0_l0.ogg.text: A visitor! Do you read? Can you read? Do you return things? Two out of three and we'll get along.

q007_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q007_o0_l1.ogg.text: I was airing the old jade slips and I dozed off. The mountain wind took three into the plum garden.

q007_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q007_o0_l2.ogg.text: Bring them back and I'll lend you the Azure Cloud Breathing Manual. The good edition, with footnotes.

q007_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q007_o2_l0.ogg.text: Most of the slips are breathing exercises. One is a list of Elder Bai's favourite teas, annotated with fierce opinions.

q007_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q007_o2_l1.ogg.text: The last is older, its jade gone milky. It shows two sects' banners side by side: an azure cloud and a green lotus.

q007_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q007_o3_l0.ogg.text: All three! And no corners folded. You may live.

q007_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q007_o3_l1.ogg.text: This one here is old history. The Verdant Lotus Sect, who stood beside our founder three centuries ago.

q007_o3_l3.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q007_o3_l3.ogg.text: They bled so that this land might sleep. Now nobody remembers their name. That is the fate of heroes, mostly.

q008_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q008_o0_l0.ogg.text: This array links to a greater one, far below the mountains. It is called the Azure Heaven Seal.

q008_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q008_o0_l1.ogg.text: What it seals is none of your business yet. What IS your business is that the spirit lamps are dry.

q008_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q008_o0_l2.ogg.text: Someone overturned the oil cart in the pine woods. Monkeys, the gate disciple claims. Fetch four jars.

q008_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q008_o2_l0.ogg.text: As the last lamp flares, the array's runes turn to face you like flowers following the sun.

q008_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q008_o2_l1.ogg.text: Your pendant blazes green. For a heartbeat you hear distant chanting, and something vast beneath the earth turns over in its sleep.

q008_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q008_o3_l0.ogg.text: The array flared. Every rune, all at once. It has not done that in three hundred years.

q008_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q008_o3_l1.ogg.text: You were standing at its heart. Show me that pendant.

q008_o3_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q008_o3_l2_f.ogg.text: It's only my mother's jade, Elder.

q008_o3_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q008_o3_l2_m.ogg.text: It's only my mother's jade, Elder.

q008_o3_l3.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q008_o3_l3.ogg.text: Hm. Yes. A trinket. The array must be aging. Go, disciple, and speak of this to no one.

q009_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q009_o0_l0.ogg.text: Pine needles crunch underfoot. Between the trunks, pairs of eyes glow the colour of fresh blood.

q009_o0_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q009_o0_l1_f.ogg.text: Spirit wolves? This close to the sect?

q009_o0_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q009_o0_l1_m.ogg.text: Spirit wolves? This close to the sect?

q009_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q009_o2_l0.ogg.text: The bronze bell booms across the mountain. Lanterns flare to life in every courtyard.

q009_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q009_o3_l0.ogg.text: Wha... I'm up! I'm up! I was guarding. With my ears. Very closely.

q009_o3_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q009_o3_l1_f.ogg.text: There were wolves in the pines, Lu Ping. With red eyes.

q009_o3_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q009_o3_l1_m.ogg.text: There were wolves in the pines, Lu Ping. With red eyes.

q009_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q009_o3_l2.ogg.text: Red eyes? That's an old granny story. Red eyes mean the Blood Moon is... oh. Oh no.

q009_o4_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q009_o4_l0.ogg.text: Corrupted wolves. Their qi was poisoned with blood. That hasn't happened since the Blood Moon Sect fell.

q009_o4_l1_f.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q009_o4_l1_f.ogg.text: Probably a stray demonic cultivator passing through. Probably. You did well, Junior Sister. Get some rest.

q009_o4_l1_m.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q009_o4_l1_m.ogg.text: Probably a stray demonic cultivator passing through. Probably. You did well, Junior Brother. Get some rest.

q010_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q010_o0_l0.ogg.text: Elder Mo says you're ready. He said it grumpily, which means he's proud.

q010_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q010_o0_l1.ogg.text: This is a Qi Gathering Pill. Swallow it at the cliff edge. The sea of clouds will steady your mind.

q010_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q010_o1_l0.ogg.text: The pill dissolves into fire. Qi floods your meridians like a spring thaw, cold, then burning, then clear.

q010_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q010_o1_l1.ogg.text: The sea of clouds churns below. The scattered spark in your dantian draws tight and becomes a bright, steady pearl of qi.

q010_o1_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q010_o1_l2_f.ogg.text: So this is Qi Condensation. I can hear the mountain breathing.

q010_o1_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q010_o1_l2_m.ogg.text: So this is Qi Condensation. I can hear the mountain breathing.

q010_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q010_o2_l0.ogg.text: Yun Qingyao. Sect Master of the Azure Cloud. I felt your breakthrough from the hall. It was very... loud.

q010_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q010_o2_l1.ogg.text: Elder Mo tells me the formation array answered you, and that wolves with red eyes came to our wall.

q010_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q010_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Omens come in pairs, they say. I would rather they didn't. Rest well, Su Yue. Tomorrow the sect needs you.

q010_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q010_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Omens come in pairs, they say. I would rather they didn't. Rest well, Lin Feng. Tomorrow the sect needs you.

q010_o2_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q010_o2_l3_f.ogg.text: I will not disappoint you, Sect Master.

q010_o2_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q010_o2_l3_m.ogg.text: I will not disappoint you, Sect Master.

q011_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q011_o0_l0.ogg.text: The Medicine Hall needs moonshadow grass. It grows in the Whispering Bamboo, beyond the wolf dens.

q011_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q011_o0_l1.ogg.text: Wei Tong will go with you. Take the teleport array outside the gate. Be back within three days.

q011_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q011_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: The wolf dens? After what we saw in the pines?

q011_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q011_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: The wolf dens? After what we saw in the pines?

q011_o0_l3.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q011_o0_l3.ogg.text: A cultivator who fears wolves should have stayed a farmer. Go.

q011_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q011_o2_l0.ogg.text: Smell that? Bamboo shoots. Wild mushrooms. Freedom. I packed twelve buns, in case of emergencies.

q011_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q011_o2_l1.ogg.text: Moonshadow grass grows in the sunny grove ahead. We pick it, we go home, nobody gets eaten.

q011_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q011_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Why do I feel like you've said that before?

q011_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q011_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Why do I feel like you've said that before?

q011_o2_l3.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q011_o2_l3.ogg.text: Because I have. Twice. Once somebody got eaten. Only a little bit, though.

q012_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q012_o0_l0.ogg.text: There! Moonshadow grass. See how it glows? Pick the silver ones. The blue ones make you sneeze for a week.

q012_o2_l0_f.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q012_o2_l0_f.ogg.text: Wolves! In broad daylight? Back to back, Junior Sister!

q012_o2_l0_m.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q012_o2_l0_m.ogg.text: Wolves! In broad daylight? Back to back, Junior Brother!

q012_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q012_o3_l0.ogg.text: Spirit wolves don't hunt at noon. And they don't hunt cultivators. We taste of pills and bad temper.

q012_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q012_o3_l2.ogg.text: Not yet. Something's driving them out of their den. Let's find out what, then eat. Or eat, then find out.

q013_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q013_o0_l0.ogg.text: The hollow reeks of old blood. Bones lie in neat rows, far too neat for wolves.

q013_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q013_o0_l1.ogg.text: On the cave wall, someone has painted a crescent moon swallowing a sword. The paint is still wet.

q013_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q013_o0_l2.ogg.text: That's not wolf art. Wolves can't hold brushes. I checked once.

q013_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q013_o3_l0.ogg.text: The roots are black. Somebody fed these wolves blood, cultivator blood, and on purpose.

q013_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q013_o3_l1.ogg.text: Elder Hua can study these. And the den is not empty. Something bigger is still in there.

q014_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q014_o0_l0.ogg.text: A howl shakes the bamboo. Something the size of an ox pads out of the cave, eyes like two red lanterns.

q014_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q014_o1_l0.ogg.text: That's the wolf king! Its fur used to be silver... they've turned it into a monster!

q014_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q014_o2_l0.ogg.text: You press a purifying talisman to the great beast's brow. The red drains from its fur, leaving it silver again.

q014_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q014_o2_l1.ogg.text: Rest easy, old king. It wasn't your fault.

q014_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q014_o3_l0.ogg.text: Clean work. The wolf king was old when your sect master was a child. It deserved a better death.

q014_o3_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q014_o3_l1_f.ogg.text: Who are you? Did you do this?

q014_o3_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q014_o3_l1_m.ogg.text: Who are you? Did you do this?

q014_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q014_o3_l2.ogg.text: If I had, you would be dead. The wolves were fed blood. Someone is testing an old recipe.

q014_o3_l3.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q014_o3_l3.ogg.text: Go home, little disciple. Keep that pendant under your robe. There are eyes in this forest older than mine.

q015_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q015_o0_l0.ogg.text: If I die, tell my mother I died heroically. And tell the kitchen to stop making the bitter melon.

q015_o0_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q015_o0_l1_f.ogg.text: You're not dying. You're just heavy.

q015_o0_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q015_o0_l1_m.ogg.text: You're not dying. You're just heavy.

q015_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q015_o1_l0.ogg.text: Wolf king claws. Blood-soaked, too. Put him down on the mat, not on my tea.

q015_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q015_o1_l1.ogg.text: The wound drinks qi. It needs water from the spirit spring, drawn by someone with a clean heart.

q015_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q015_o1_l3.ogg.text: Follow the sound of the frogs. They are loud and very proud of it.

q015_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q015_o2_l0.ogg.text: The water glows where your gourd touches it. The lotus pads turn slowly toward you, then toward your pendant.

q015_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q015_o2_l1.ogg.text: For a moment the spring shows a reflection that is not yours: a woman in green robes, holding a lotus. Then it is gone.

q015_o4_l0.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q015_o4_l0.ogg.text: The spring gave you water. It usually just gives people wet boots.

q015_o4_l1.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q015_o4_l1.ogg.text: Your friend will live, and complain, which is how you know he is alive.

q015_o4_l2.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q015_o4_l2.ogg.text: That jade you carry... no. Old men see ghosts everywhere. Mind the ruins to the north, child. They remember.

q016_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q016_o0_l0.ogg.text: I'm alive! And I smell roast pork. Either I've died and gone somewhere nice, or there's a camp nearby.

q016_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q016_o0_l1.ogg.text: Bandits, probably. The rogue cultivator kind. Let's take a look from the ridge before we do anything stupid.

q016_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q016_o1_l0.ogg.text: Below: tents, a fire, crates stamped with a merchant guild's seal. And cages. Cages full of mortals.

q016_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q016_o1_l1.ogg.text: Those are townsfolk. Look at their clothes. Qingshi, maybe. What do bandits want with farmers?

q016_o1_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q016_o1_l2_f.ogg.text: Nothing good. We free them tonight.

q016_o1_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q016_o1_l2_m.ogg.text: Nothing good. We free them tonight.

q016_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q016_o1_l3.ogg.text: Tonight. Right. After dinner. Kidding! Mostly kidding.

q016_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q016_o2_l0.ogg.text: The fire burns low. The guards trade places. Inside the cages, a child is crying very quietly.

q017_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q017_o0_l0.ogg.text: Sect brats! On your feet, you drunks! Iron-Fang Tie Hu doesn't lose cargo!

q017_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q017_o1_l0.ogg.text: The lock snaps. The prisoners stumble out, blinking, too frightened to cry.

q017_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q017_o1_l1.ogg.text: An old farmer grips your sleeve. They took us from Qingshi, he whispers. Every new moon, more of us vanish.

q017_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q017_o2_l0.ogg.text: Kill them! The buyer pays for heads, whole or not!

q018_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q018_o0_l0.ogg.text: Silver, forged papers, and at the bottom a token of blood-red jade, carved with a moon swallowing a sword.

q018_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q018_o0_l1.ogg.text: It is cold as a corpse. Your pendant flares green, and the token hisses like a burnt insect.

q018_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q018_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: The same mark as the den. This is no ordinary bandit's loot.

q018_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q018_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: The same mark as the den. This is no ordinary bandit's loot.

q018_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q018_o1_l0.ogg.text: A moon eating a sword. My grandmother used to scare me with that. Be good or the Blood Moon takes you.

q018_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q018_o1_l1.ogg.text: The hermit's old. Older than old. If anyone knows what this is, he does.

q018_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q018_o2_l0.ogg.text: Put that thing down. Not on my tea! Not on anything I love.

q018_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q018_o2_l1.ogg.text: That is a Blood Moon Sect command token. Three hundred years ago, one of those could order a city to bleed.

q018_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q018_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: The Blood Moon Sect was destroyed. Everyone says so.

q018_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q018_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: The Blood Moon Sect was destroyed. Everyone says so.

q018_o2_l3.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q018_o2_l3.ogg.text: Everyone says a great many things. The dead are rarely consulted. Take it to your elders. Quickly.

q019_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q019_o0_l0.ogg.text: That token isn't yours, brat. Hand it over and I'll leave you both your legs.

q019_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q019_o0_l2.ogg.text: Brave. I like brave. Brave screams louder.

q019_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q019_o2_l0.ogg.text: Iron-Fang ran again. He is a coward with good instincts, which is the most dangerous kind.

q019_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q019_o2_l1.ogg.text: You found a Blood Moon token. Do you know how many people will kill for that? Now more will.

q019_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q019_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Then help me. Tell me what's happening.

q019_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q019_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Then help me. Tell me what's happening.

q019_o2_l3.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q019_o2_l3.ogg.text: The Blood Moon rises. That is all you need to know. Tell your sect master, and trust fewer people than you'd like.

q020_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q020_o0_l0.ogg.text: Home! I can smell the kitchens from here. Tell Elder Gu about the token, I'll tell the cook about my stomach.

q020_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q020_o1_l0.ogg.text: A Blood Moon command token. Where did a bandit get this?

q020_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q020_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: His buyer, I think. They're kidnapping mortals from Qingshi. And a masked man warned us the Blood Moon is rising.

q020_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q020_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: His buyer, I think. They're kidnapping mortals from Qingshi. And a masked man warned us the Blood Moon is rising.

q020_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q020_o1_l2.ogg.text: Rumours and masks. The Law Hall will take this into custody and investigate. Properly. Hand it over.

q020_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q020_o1_l3.ogg.text: You did well, disciple. Now forget you ever saw it. That is an order.

q020_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q020_o2_l0.ogg.text: Gu took the token? Well, it is his right. The Law Hall handles matters of the demonic path.

q020_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q020_o2_l1.ogg.text: Still. Kidnapped mortals, fed wolves, command tokens. I don't like the shape of this.

q020_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q020_o2_l2.ogg.text: I'll speak to the Sect Master. Wei Tong says you carried him on your back. Hmph. Good.

q021_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q021_o0_l0.ogg.text: The captives you freed are from Qingshi. They say someone takes people every new moon, and nobody stops it.

q021_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q021_o0_l1.ogg.text: The Law Hall is investigating the token. I want eyes in the town. Han Xue will go with you.

q021_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q021_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: Mortals are not our subjects, Su Yue. They are our reason. Remember that.

q021_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q021_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: Mortals are not our subjects, Lin Feng. They are our reason. Remember that.

q021_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: constable_du
q021_o2_l0.ogg.text: Cultivators. Finally. I sent three petitions to the yamen and two to the gods. You're the first to answer.

q021_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: constable_du
q021_o2_l1.ogg.text: Eleven people in four months. Farmers, a fisherman's boy, a young man from your sect visiting his mother.

q021_o2_l3.ogg.speaker: constable_du
q021_o2_l3.ogg.text: Said his name was Xiao Shi. Asked too many questions. Then one morning he didn't come back from the river.

q022_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q022_o0_l0.ogg.text: Shutters close as you pass. A mother pulls her son indoors. The town looks at your sect robes like a sick man at a doctor.

q022_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q022_o0_l1.ogg.text: They're afraid. Not of us. Of whatever makes people disappear.

q022_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: innkeeper_fang
q022_o1_l0.ogg.text: Immortals in my inn! Sit, sit. Wine is ten coppers, noodles are five, gossip is free but you must tip.

q022_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: innkeeper_fang
q022_o1_l1.ogg.text: People vanish at the new moon, yes. And the temple keeper buries whoever the river gives back.

q022_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: innkeeper_fang
q022_o1_l2.ogg.text: Poor Keeper Hong. Such a gentle old man. He cries at every funeral, even the dogs'.

q022_o1_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q022_o1_l3_f.ogg.text: The river gives some of them back?

q022_o1_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q022_o1_l3_m.ogg.text: The river gives some of them back?

q022_o1_l4.ogg.speaker: innkeeper_fang
q022_o1_l4.ogg.text: Only bits, dear. Only bits. More wine?

q022_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: magistrate_zhou
q022_o2_l0.ogg.text: Ah, the immortals. Welcome, welcome. As you can see, the yamen has matters entirely in hand.

q022_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: magistrate_zhou
q022_o2_l1.ogg.text: People wander off. Mortals are like that. Gambling, debts, pretty widows in other towns.

q022_o2_l3.ogg.speaker: magistrate_zhou
q022_o2_l3.ogg.text: A rounded number! Bring me proof, and the yamen will act. Until then, please don't frighten the tax base.

q023_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: widow_liu
q023_o0_l0.ogg.text: My Liu Er went to fetch the nets at dusk. The river was calm. He swam like a fish, my boy.

q023_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: widow_liu
q023_o0_l1.ogg.text: They say he drowned. His body never came back. The river gives back everyone eventually.

q023_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q023_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: I'll find out what happened to him. I promise.

q023_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q023_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: I'll find out what happened to him. I promise.

q023_o0_l3.ogg.speaker: widow_liu
q023_o0_l3.ogg.text: Don't promise, young immortal. Promises are heavy. Just look. That's enough.

q023_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: ferryman_pan
q023_o1_l0.ogg.text: Seen something? Forty years on this water, I've seen everything twice.

q023_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: ferryman_pan
q023_o1_l1.ogg.text: New moon, two months back. Lanterns moving on the far bank, toward the hill graves. Pale folk, carrying sacks.

q023_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: ferryman_pan
q023_o1_l2.ogg.text: Sacks that wriggled. I told the magistrate. He told me to drink less. I drink exactly the right amount.

q023_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q023_o2_l0.ogg.text: Among the reeds: a broken sandal, a torn net, and footprints leading uphill, pressed deep, as if carrying weight.

q023_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q023_o2_l1.ogg.text: Five people. One dragged. Toward the graveyard.

q023_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q023_o3_l0.ogg.text: The well water is clean. Whatever took the townsfolk did not poison them. It wanted them healthy.

q024_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q024_o0_l0.ogg.text: Smell that? Beneath the fried dough. Blood lotus. It's used in demonic pills.

q024_o0_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q024_o0_l1_f.ogg.text: It's coming from the guild carts. They're heading to the warehouse.

q024_o0_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q024_o0_l1_m.ogg.text: It's coming from the guild carts. They're heading to the warehouse.

q024_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: merchant_jin
q024_o1_l0.ogg.text: Jin Baoshan, master of the merchant guild. What an honour. Buying? Selling? Leaving?

q024_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: merchant_jin
q024_o1_l1.ogg.text: Blood lotus? Never heard of it. Is it a flower? We deal in silk, tea and entirely legal things.

q024_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q024_o1_l2.ogg.text: Your crates are dripping red, Master Jin.

q024_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: merchant_jin
q024_o1_l3.ogg.text: Imported beets. Very juicy. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a pressing appointment elsewhere. Anywhere.

q024_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q024_o2_l0.ogg.text: Under the silk bolts: dried blood lotus, bundled by the dozen, and a ledger.

q024_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q024_o2_l1.ogg.text: Every entry is paid in silver by a buyer who signs with a crescent moon. Deliveries: the hill graves, at the new moon.

q024_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q024_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: The graveyard again. Jin knows exactly who he's selling to.

q024_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q024_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: The graveyard again. Jin knows exactly who he's selling to.

q025_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q025_o0_l0.ogg.text: Masked figures in black and crimson drag a struggling woman toward the town wall.

q025_o0_l1_f.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q025_o0_l1_f.ogg.text: Demonic cultivators. Inside the town walls. Su Yue, left side. I'll take the right.

q025_o0_l1_m.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q025_o0_l1_m.ogg.text: Demonic cultivators. Inside the town walls. Lin Feng, left side. I'll take the right.

q025_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q025_o3_l0.ogg.text: Sleep talismans. Blood-ink. These people know the town, the patrols, even which windows don't lock.

q025_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q025_o3_l1.ogg.text: And I saw someone on the rooftops, watching. A masked man. He didn't help. He didn't run either.

q025_o3_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q025_o3_l2_f.ogg.text: I've met him. In the bamboo forest. He warned me about the Blood Moon.

q025_o3_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q025_o3_l2_m.ogg.text: I've met him. In the bamboo forest. He warned me about the Blood Moon.

q025_o3_l3.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q025_o3_l3.ogg.text: A man who knows that much about demons... either hunts them, or is one.

q026_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: innkeeper_fang
q026_o0_l0.ogg.text: The mask? Pays in old coins, never eats, never drinks, never smiles. My ideal guest, honestly.

q026_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: innkeeper_fang
q026_o0_l1.ogg.text: He goes up the watchtower every night and stares at the fields. Romantic, or murderous. Could be both.

q026_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q026_o1_l0.ogg.text: From the tower, the terraced fields shine under a thin moon. A lone figure stands among the rice, looking up at you.

q026_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q026_o1_l1.ogg.text: He knows we're here. He wants us to come.

q026_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q026_o2_l0.ogg.text: You've been talking about me. I'm flattered. Also, you're wrong.

q026_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q026_o2_l1.ogg.text: Then explain why you're always near demons.

q026_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q026_o2_l2.ogg.text: Because I hunt them. I've tracked this nest for a year. Ask who tends the dead in this town.

q026_o2_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q026_o2_l3_f.ogg.text: The temple keeper? Everyone says he's gentle.

q026_o2_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q026_o2_l3_m.ogg.text: The temple keeper? Everyone says he's gentle.

q026_o2_l4.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q026_o2_l4.ogg.text: Everyone said I was gentle once, too. Look beneath his graves. Then decide who to trust.

q027_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q027_o0_l0.ogg.text: Fresh graves, far too many. Each mound is marked with a neat temple tablet and a sprig of dried blood lotus.

q027_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q027_o1_l0.ogg.text: You brush the soil aside. The graves are empty, and beneath them runs a circle of blood-ink runes.

q027_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q027_o1_l1.ogg.text: A blood-gathering formation. Whoever's buried here never died here. They were taken somewhere, alive.

q027_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q027_o3_l0.ogg.text: The tablets are temple tablets. Only Keeper Hong carves these.

q027_o3_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q027_o3_l1_f.ogg.text: Madam Fang said he cries at every funeral.

q027_o3_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q027_o3_l1_m.ogg.text: Madam Fang said he cries at every funeral.

q027_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q027_o3_l2.ogg.text: Some people cry at funerals because they're sad. Others because they're hungry. Let's pay him a visit.

q028_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
q028_o0_l0.ogg.text: Young immortals! Come in, come in. Tea? It's a special blend. Very calming.

q028_o0_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q028_o0_l1_f.ogg.text: It smells of blood lotus, Keeper.

q028_o0_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q028_o0_l1_m.ogg.text: It smells of blood lotus, Keeper.

q028_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
q028_o0_l2.ogg.text: Does it? Old nose, old tea. Such strong young cultivators. Such... vigorous blood.

q028_o0_l3.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
q028_o0_l3.ogg.text: And that pendant. Green jade, lotus-carved. Oh, the Patriarch will be so very pleased with me.

q028_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
q028_o2_l0.ogg.text: Hold them, my children! I must prepare the graves!

q029_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: magistrate_zhou
q029_o0_l0.ogg.text: The temple keeper? I had tea with him every week! He blessed my house! He... he blessed my house.

q029_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: magistrate_zhou
q029_o0_l1.ogg.text: I was a fool and a coward. The yamen guards are yours. Tell me what to do.

q029_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q029_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: Keep the townsfolk indoors. We'll end this tonight.

q029_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q029_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: Keep the townsfolk indoors. We'll end this tonight.

q029_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q029_o1_l0.ogg.text: The rune circle burns red. Keeper Hong stands at its centre, his kindly face peeling away like wet paper.

q029_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
q029_o2_l0.ogg.text: Three hundred hearts I have gathered for the Patriarch. Yours will make it three hundred and one.

q029_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
q029_o2_l2.ogg.text: Dead? Oh, child. He is only hungry.

q029_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
q029_o3_l0.ogg.text: Too late. The taken are already in the Abyss. The Blood Moon Abyss. Their blood drips on the seal as we speak.

q029_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
q029_o3_l1.ogg.text: You think your sect protects you? The Patriarch has friends in high halls. Very high.

q029_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: keeper_hong
q029_o3_l2.ogg.text: Lotus-bearer... he is coming for you. He has always been coming for you.

q030_o0_l0_f.ogg.speaker: player
q030_o0_l0_f.ogg.text: Your son didn't drown. He was taken. To a place called the Blood Moon Abyss. He may still be alive.

q030_o0_l0_m.ogg.speaker: player
q030_o0_l0_m.ogg.text: Your son didn't drown. He was taken. To a place called the Blood Moon Abyss. He may still be alive.

q030_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: widow_liu
q030_o0_l1.ogg.text: Alive? Don't... don't give me hope unless you mean it, immortal.

q030_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q030_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: I mean it. I'll look for him. For him and for everyone they took.

q030_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q030_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: I mean it. I'll look for him. For him and for everyone they took.

q030_o0_l3.ogg.speaker: widow_liu
q030_o0_l3.ogg.text: Then I'll keep the water sweet until you do.

q030_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: innkeeper_fang
q030_o1_l0.ogg.text: The heroes of Qingshi! Free noodles for life. Well, for a year. Well, one bowl. Today. Eat quickly.

q030_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: innkeeper_fang
q030_o1_l1.ogg.text: Truly, dear. Thank you. That old snake served me tea for ten years. I'll be checking my teeth for a month.

q030_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q030_o2_l0.ogg.text: You burn clean incense and let your qi wash through the hall. The smell of blood lotus fades, and a sparrow returns to the eaves.

q030_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q030_o3_l0.ogg.text: He said the Patriarch has friends in high halls. Very high.

q030_o3_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q030_o3_l1_f.ogg.text: You think someone in our sect...

q030_o3_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q030_o3_l1_m.ogg.text: You think someone in our sect...

q030_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q030_o3_l2.ogg.text: I think we should say it only to the Sect Master. And we should find out where Xiao Shi is before his sister does.

q031_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q031_o0_l0.ogg.text: A Blood Moon deacon, three hundred stolen hearts, and a hint of friends in high halls. I will not sleep tonight.

q031_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q031_o0_l1.ogg.text: Three centuries ago our founder and the Verdant Lotus Sect sealed the Blood Moon Patriarch beneath the Abyss.

q031_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q031_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: Elder Bai keeps the records. Learn how the seal was made, Su Yue. If it is failing, I must know why.

q031_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q031_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: Elder Bai keeps the records. Learn how the seal was made, Lin Feng. If it is failing, I must know why.

q031_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q031_o1_l0.ogg.text: The Blood Moon War chronicles? Fourth floor, east shelf, beside the recipes for turtle soup. Do not ask.

q031_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q031_o1_l1.ogg.text: Here... hm. Hm! The pages on the Azure Heaven Seal are gone. Cut out. With a very sharp, very tidy blade.

q031_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q031_o1_l2.ogg.text: Only elders and the Law Hall may enter the fourth floor. Whoever did this had a pass, and patience.

q031_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q031_o1_l3.ogg.text: The Verdant Lotus built the seal. Their ruins lie in the Whispering Bamboo. Stones cannot be cut out of a book.

q031_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q031_o3_l0.ogg.text: A stone archway rises from the bamboo, choked with vines. Carved lotus flowers climb its pillars.

q031_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q031_o3_l1.ogg.text: At its keystone is a single lotus, exactly the shape of the jade at your belt.

q032_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q032_o0_l0.ogg.text: The hermit sits outside with two cups of tea already poured. He does not look surprised to see you.

q032_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q032_o1_l0.ogg.text: You went to the ruins. Of course you did. The young never listen and the old never stop talking.

q032_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q032_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: The keystone matches my pendant. You knew. The first time you saw it, you knew.

q032_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q032_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: The keystone matches my pendant. You knew. The first time you saw it, you knew.

q032_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q032_o1_l2.ogg.text: I did. Sit down. This tea has waited three hundred years. It can wait for one more story.

q032_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q032_o3_l0.ogg.text: My name is Lan Jue. Last disciple of the Verdant Lotus Sect. I ran when my masters died. I have been running ever since.

q032_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q032_o3_l1.ogg.text: Your pendant is the Lotus Key, half of what binds the Azure Heaven Seal. Your mother was of our blood.

q032_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q032_o3_l2.ogg.text: The ruins will test you. Gather the rune stones scattered at the gate, and the arch will know its heir.

q032_o3_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q032_o3_l3_f.ogg.text: You could have come with me.

q032_o3_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q032_o3_l3_m.ogg.text: You could have come with me.

q032_o3_l4.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q032_o3_l4.ogg.text: I could have done many things for three hundred years. Go. I will follow when my shame lets me.

q033_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q033_o1_l0.ogg.text: Don't look so surprised. You're not the only one who can walk through bamboo.

q033_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q033_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: You followed me? From the sect?

q033_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q033_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: You followed me? From the sect?

q033_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q033_o1_l2.ogg.text: Elder Gu ordered me to keep an eye on you. He said you carry something the sect must protect.

q033_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q033_o1_l3.ogg.text: Personally, I think it's a waste of my talents. But a Zhao obeys the Law Hall. So. Lead on, village brat.

q033_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q033_o2_l0.ogg.text: Here the Verdant Lotus gave its heart. With the Azure Cloud we bound the Patriarch Xue Wuji beneath the Abyss.

q033_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q033_o2_l1.ogg.text: The seal has two keys. The Lotus Key, which binds. The Azure Eye, which watches. Never let both fall to one hand.

q033_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q033_o2_l2.ogg.text: The Azure Eye... that's the formation array at home. And the Lotus Key is... your trinket?

q033_o2_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q033_o2_l3_f.ogg.text: Apparently my trinket is older than your clan.

q033_o2_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q033_o2_l3_m.ogg.text: Apparently my trinket is older than your clan.

q034_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q034_o0_l0.ogg.text: Stone men! Wonderful. My sword was freshly polished, too.

q034_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q034_o1_l0.ogg.text: The rune stones slide into place one by one. The carved lotus on the keystone opens its petals.

q034_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q034_o1_l1.ogg.text: With a sound like a sigh, the vines fall away and the gate of the Verdant Lotus opens for the first time in three centuries.

q034_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q034_o1_l2.ogg.text: It... opened. For you. Fine. FINE. I'm not impressed. I'm slightly impressed.

q034_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q034_o2_l0.ogg.text: Beyond the arch lies a courtyard of green stone. At its centre kneels a giant statue, head bowed, hands resting on a sword.

q034_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q034_o2_l1.ogg.text: Please tell me that one doesn't move.

q035_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q035_o0_l0.ogg.text: I followed. My shame is slower than my feet, it turns out.

q035_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q035_o0_l1.ogg.text: The guardian in the courtyard was carved by my master. It asks one question with its fists: are you worthy?

q035_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q035_o0_l2.ogg.text: Do not fear it. It is not cruel, only very, very thorough.

q035_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q035_o1_l0.ogg.text: The sentinels are reforming. Break them again, quickly, before the guardian wakes!

q035_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q035_o2_l0.ogg.text: The great statue lifts its head. Moss sloughs from its shoulders. A voice grinds like millstones: who bears the lotus?

q035_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q035_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: I do. Su Yue, of the Azure Cloud. And of the Verdant Lotus.

q035_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q035_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: I do. Lin Feng, of the Azure Cloud. And of the Verdant Lotus.

q035_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: narrator
q035_o2_l2.ogg.text: Then show me that the lotus has not wilted.

q036_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q036_o0_l0.ogg.text: Inside lies a jade slip carved with lotus roots: the Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra, and a letter in an elegant hand.

q036_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q036_o0_l1.ogg.text: To whoever carries my key. I am sorry for the burden. It was always meant to be shared. Do not carry it alone.

q036_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q036_o1_l0.ogg.text: The sutra unfolds in your mind like a flower opening underwater. Roots, stem, blossom. Patience, strength, compassion.

q036_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q036_o1_l1.ogg.text: Your qi begins to settle, layer upon layer, like silt forming bedrock.

q036_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q036_o2_l0.ogg.text: You read it. I can see it in your breathing. The lotus grows in mud and is not stained.

q036_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q036_o2_l1.ogg.text: Three hundred years I waited for someone to open that box. I thought I would feel relief. I feel... old.

q036_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q036_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Come back to the sect with me. Tell them what you know.

q036_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q036_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Come back to the sect with me. Tell them what you know.

q036_o2_l3.ogg.speaker: hermit_lan
q036_o2_l3.ogg.text: One day. Not yet. First I must forgive a coward, and he is very stubborn.

q037_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q037_o0_l0.ogg.text: They're smashing the stele! Barbarians! That's at least a thousand years of calligraphy!

q037_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q037_o1_l0.ogg.text: It's a scratch. Don't fuss. A Zhao doesn't bleed. We... tactically leak.

q037_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q037_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: You stepped in front of that blade for me.

q037_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q037_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: You stepped in front of that blade for me.

q037_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q037_o1_l2.ogg.text: Don't be sentimental. Nobody gets to defeat you except me. I've been planning it for months.

q038_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q038_o0_l0.ogg.text: Home. I'm going to bathe for three days. Don't tell anyone I helped you. I have a reputation for being unbearable.

q038_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q038_o1_l0.ogg.text: The Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra. I have waited my whole life to see this. I may cry. Don't look.

q038_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q038_o1_l1.ogg.text: Keep it. It is bound to the Lotus Key and would only sulk in my shelves.

q038_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q038_o1_l2.ogg.text: And the missing pages... the fourth-floor log shows a Law Hall seal. The Law Hall borrows everything. It's how they keep us honest.

q038_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q038_o2_l0.ogg.text: Zhao Kang tells me you found a Verdant Lotus relic. The Law Hall will take custody of it. For safekeeping.

q038_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q038_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: With respect, Elder, the Sect Master ordered me to keep it.

q038_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q038_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: With respect, Elder, the Sect Master ordered me to keep it.

q038_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q038_o2_l2.ogg.text: Did she. Then keep it, disciple. Keep it very close. Things kept close are the easiest to lose.

q038_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q038_o3_l0.ogg.text: Gu wanted the sutra? Don't take it to heart. He's been cold ever since his daughter died. Twenty years now.

q038_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q038_o3_l1.ogg.text: Gu Lan. A bright girl. Meridian sickness. No pill could save her. He searched the whole world.

q038_o3_l2_f.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q038_o3_l2_f.ogg.text: Grief is a heart demon that never stops whispering. Be patient with him, Junior Sister. For my sake.

q038_o3_l2_m.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q038_o3_l2_m.ogg.text: Grief is a heart demon that never stops whispering. Be patient with him, Junior Brother. For my sake.

q039_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q039_o0_l0.ogg.text: A Foundation Pill needs lotus root from the pond, gathered at dusk, and five spirit stones to fire the cauldron.

q039_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q039_o0_l1.ogg.text: The stones come from the treasury. Good luck with that.

q039_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: steward_qian
q039_o1_l0.ogg.text: Five spirit stones? Five? Do you know what five spirit stones could buy? Five spirit stones!

q039_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q039_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: It's for a Foundation Pill. The Sect Master approved it.

q039_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q039_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: It's for a Foundation Pill. The Sect Master approved it.

q039_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: steward_qian
q039_o1_l2.ogg.text: Approved it. Everyone approves things. Nobody counts things. Fine. Take them. Sign here. And here. And here.

q039_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q039_o3_l0.ogg.text: You're back! Did you go through Qingshi? Did you see my brother? Did he say why he hasn't written?

q039_o3_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q039_o3_l1_f.ogg.text: Xiao Man... Xiao Shi was taken. By the same people who took the townsfolk. I think he's alive.

q039_o3_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q039_o3_l1_m.ogg.text: Xiao Man... Xiao Shi was taken. By the same people who took the townsfolk. I think he's alive.

q039_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q039_o3_l2.ogg.text: Taken? But he... he's so bad at fighting. He faints at the sight of needles.

q039_o3_l3.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q039_o3_l3.ogg.text: Promise me you'll bring him back. No. Don't promise. Just... do it. Please.

q040_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q040_o0_l0.ogg.text: Breakthroughs attract trouble. Heart demons, jealous juniors, very curious elders. I'll stand guard.

q040_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q040_o0_l1.ogg.text: The plum garden is quiet at night, and Zhao Kang is too injured to sulk there. Go.

q040_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q040_o1_l0.ogg.text: Your qi pours downward like a waterfall into your dantian, and there it hardens, layer upon layer, into a foundation of jade.

q040_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q040_o1_l1.ogg.text: Beneath the plum blossoms, a single green lotus flickers into being around you, and slowly sinks into your heart.

q040_o1_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q040_o1_l2_f.ogg.text: I can feel every blossom on every branch. Is this what the elders feel all the time?

q040_o1_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q040_o1_l2_m.ogg.text: I can feel every blossom on every branch. Is this what the elders feel all the time?

q040_o2_l0_f.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q040_o2_l0_f.ogg.text: Foundation Establishment, and a Verdant Lotus sutra. You grow faster than my worries, Su Yue. Barely.

q040_o2_l0_m.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q040_o2_l0_m.ogg.text: Foundation Establishment, and a Verdant Lotus sutra. You grow faster than my worries, Lin Feng. Barely.

q040_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q040_o2_l1.ogg.text: In one month the sect holds the Inner Sect Tournament. The winner earns a place at my side, and the Azure Eye's trust.

q040_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q040_o2_l2.ogg.text: I want you to enter. And I want whoever cut those pages to watch you win.

q041_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q041_o1_l0.ogg.text: Banners of every peak ring the plaza. Disciples crowd the walls and railings. Someone is selling roasted chestnuts at twice the price.

q041_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: steward_qian
q041_o2_l0.ogg.text: Registration fee: two spirit stones. Non-refundable. Especially if you lose. Particularly if you die.

q041_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q041_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: The Sect Master told me to enter. Personally.

q041_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q041_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: The Sect Master told me to enter. Personally.

q041_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: steward_qian
q041_o2_l2.ogg.text: Then the Sect Master can pay. Fine, fine. Waived. Don't tell anyone. I have a reputation.

q041_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q041_o3_l0.ogg.text: The betting pool is open! Yan Tie, three-time champion, two to one. Zhao Kang, five to one.

q041_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q041_o3_l1.ogg.text: You're at nine to one. I put three stones on you. Don't tell Steward Qian. Actually, win, then tell him.

q041_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q041_o3_l2.ogg.text: Oh, and Elder Gu is supervising the pill supplies this year. First time ever. Very thorough man.

q042_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q042_o0_l0.ogg.text: Right. Foundation Establishment. So the puppets need to be angrier. I've had them tuned up.

q042_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q042_o0_l1.ogg.text: Four at once. If you get hit, you buy lunch. If you don't get hit, I buy lunch. Either way, lunch.

q042_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q042_o2_l0.ogg.text: Not a scratch. I'm buying lunch. I'm always buying lunch. How did this happen to me?

q042_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q042_o2_l1.ogg.text: Listen. Yan Tie is strong, but he fights like a landslide, all at once. Make him chase you and he'll tire.

q043_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q043_o0_l0.ogg.text: Rules: no killing, no crippling, no weeping on the formation. Last one standing advances.

q043_o0_l1_f.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q043_o0_l1_f.ogg.text: And Junior Sister? Don't embarrass me. I told the other elders you were adequate.

q043_o0_l1_m.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q043_o0_l1_m.ogg.text: And Junior Brother? Don't embarrass me. I told the other elders you were adequate.

q043_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q043_o2_l0.ogg.text: Two more from Cloud Peak who think they were robbed. Settle it.

q043_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q043_o3_l0.ogg.text: Adequate. More than adequate. Hmph. Don't let it go to your head. Heads are heavy enough already.

q043_o3_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q043_o3_l1_f.ogg.text: Was that a compliment, Elder Mo?

q043_o3_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q043_o3_l1_m.ogg.text: Was that a compliment, Elder Mo?

q043_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q043_o3_l2.ogg.text: It was an observation. Go and eat something. You look like a boiled noodle.

q044_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q044_o0_l0.ogg.text: A figure in gold-trimmed robes slips through the moon gate, carrying a bundle of incense sticks.

q044_o0_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q044_o0_l1_f.ogg.text: Sneaking out the night before the second round? What are you up to, Zhao Kang?

q044_o0_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q044_o0_l1_m.ogg.text: Sneaking out the night before the second round? What are you up to, Zhao Kang?

q044_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q044_o1_l0.ogg.text: Go ahead. Report me to the Law Hall. It's what they're for.

q044_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q044_o1_l1.ogg.text: My elder brother Zhao Ming died a year ago tonight. A Law Hall mission. Bandits, they said, in the bamboo forest.

q044_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q044_o1_l2.ogg.text: I burn incense here because he liked the view. That's all. That's all it is.

q044_o1_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q044_o1_l3_f.ogg.text: I'm sorry, Zhao Kang. Who assigned his mission?

q044_o1_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q044_o1_l3_m.ogg.text: I'm sorry, Zhao Kang. Who assigned his mission?

q044_o1_l4.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q044_o1_l4.ogg.text: Elder Gu. Same as yours. Why does that matter?

q044_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q044_o2_l0.ogg.text: Zhao Ming. I remember him. He was kind. He was also ambushed in exactly the place you were ambushed.

q044_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q044_o2_l1.ogg.text: Elder Gu assigned both missions. The Law Hall held the Blood Moon token. Law Hall seals are on the missing pages.

q044_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q044_o2_l2.ogg.text: That isn't proof. It's a pattern. I'll watch the Law Hall. You win the tournament. Don't let him see you suspect.

q045_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q045_o0_l0.ogg.text: Eliminated. By a girl half my size who hid behind a banner and poked me in the kidney. Twice.

q045_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q045_o0_l1.ogg.text: Honestly, it was brilliant. I'm going to learn it. Go on. Avenge my kidney.

q045_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q045_o1_l0.ogg.text: Second round! Everyone against everyone! Try not to hit the audience!

q045_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q045_o3_l0.ogg.text: You're into the semifinal! I've won eleven stones! I'm rich! I'm going to buy a hat!

q045_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q045_o3_l1.ogg.text: Also, a Law Hall disciple told me to stop betting on you. Rude, right? I bet more.

q046_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q046_o0_l0.ogg.text: Frenzy Pills. Blood lotus and wolf's bane, hidden inside Vitality Pills. They burn a cultivator from the inside.

q046_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q046_o0_l1.ogg.text: Three boxes were meant for the finalists' quarters. I need four moonbell herbs to brew an antidote. Hurry.

q046_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q046_o2_l0.ogg.text: The pill boxes? A disciple in Law Hall grey carried them in. He said Elder Gu approved them personally.

q046_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q046_o2_l1.ogg.text: One box went to Yan Tie's room. He's the champion. He's so strong already, why would he need pills?

q046_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q046_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Maybe he doesn't know what's in them.

q046_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q046_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Maybe he doesn't know what's in them.

q046_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q046_o3_l0.ogg.text: Good. I'll brew the antidote tonight. If Yan Tie has taken a Frenzy Pill, he will not know friend from foe.

q046_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q046_o3_l1.ogg.text: Tell no one about the Law Hall yet. An accusation without proof is just a very loud way to die.

q047_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q047_o0_l0.ogg.text: Of all the disciples in all the peaks. Fine. Stay on my left. Don't slow me down.

q047_o0_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q047_o0_l1_f.ogg.text: You're still limping from the shrine.

q047_o0_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q047_o0_l1_m.ogg.text: You're still limping from the shrine.

q047_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q047_o0_l2.ogg.text: Then stay on my right. Whatever. Just win.

q047_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q047_o1_l0.ogg.text: Five of them? Good. I was worried this would be boring.

q047_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q047_o2_l0.ogg.text: You fight like a farmer. Stubborn, unpolished, impossible to knock over.

q047_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q047_o2_l1.ogg.text: That was a compliment. Don't get used to it.

q047_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q047_o2_l2.ogg.text: Win the final. If anyone is going to beat Yan Tie, it should be the person who's going to lose to me someday.

q048_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q048_o0_l0.ogg.text: Congratulations on reaching the final. An unlikely journey for a village orphan.

q048_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q048_o0_l1.ogg.text: Tournament rules forbid external artifacts. Bring your pendant to the Law Hall tonight for inspection.

q048_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q048_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: It's not an artifact, Elder. It's a family keepsake.

q048_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q048_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: It's not an artifact, Elder. It's a family keepsake.

q048_o0_l3.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q048_o0_l3.ogg.text: Then you have nothing to fear. The Law Hall. Tonight. Do not make me ask again.

q048_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q048_o1_l0.ogg.text: Inspection? There's no such rule. There never has been. I wrote half the tournament rules myself.

q048_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q048_o1_l1.ogg.text: Gu... no. He is grieving, not wicked. Still. Don't go. If he asks, tell him I forbade it.

q048_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q048_o1_l2.ogg.text: Go and clear your head. You've a champion to face at dawn.

q048_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q048_o2_l0.ogg.text: The pond is still. The moon lies in it, whole. You breathe until your heart lies as still as the water.

q048_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q048_o3_l0.ogg.text: Gu asked for the pendant? Then he's run out of patience. That makes him dangerous.

q048_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q048_o3_l1.ogg.text: Win tomorrow. I'll be watching the pagoda. If the Law Hall moves while everyone watches the final, I'll know.

q049_o0_l0_f.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q049_o0_l0_f.ogg.text: The final! Su Yue of the Outer Court against Yan Tie of Thunder Peak, champion three years running!

q049_o0_l0_m.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q049_o0_l0_m.ogg.text: The final! Lin Feng of the Outer Court against Yan Tie of Thunder Peak, champion three years running!

q049_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q049_o0_l1.ogg.text: Bow to your opponent. Bow to the Sect Master. And for heaven's sake, bow to me.

q049_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q049_o1_l0.ogg.text: Yan Tie bows, and when he straightens, his eyes are the colour of blood. Veins crawl black up his neck.

q049_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q049_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: Frenzy qi! Stop the bout... no, he won't stop now. Su Yue, bring him down without killing him!

q049_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q049_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: Frenzy qi! Stop the bout... no, he won't stop now. Lin Feng, bring him down without killing him!

q049_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q049_o2_l0.ogg.text: Yan Tie will live. Elder Hua's antidote reached him in time. You fought to save him, not to win. I saw that.

q049_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q049_o2_l1.ogg.text: The victory is yours, and with it, a place at my side. But someone fed him that pill.

q049_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q049_o2_l2.ogg.text: Wait. The pagoda bell... someone is ringing the pagoda bell. Where is Han Xue?

q050_o0_l0_f.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q050_o0_l0_f.ogg.text: Su Yue! Elder Bai's been hurt. It's Gu. Gu is in the pagoda. The seal diagram, he's taking the seal diagram!

q050_o0_l0_m.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q050_o0_l0_m.ogg.text: Lin Feng! Elder Bai's been hurt. It's Gu. Gu is in the pagoda. The seal diagram, he's taking the seal diagram!

q050_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q050_o2_l0.ogg.text: Hold them. The pendant can wait. The diagram cannot.

q050_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q050_o3_l0.ogg.text: I'm fine. I've been hit harder by falling bookshelves. Gu Hanshan... forty years we've shared tea.

q050_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q050_o3_l1.ogg.text: He took the Azure Heaven Seal diagram. The master copy. The one we would need to repair the seal.

q050_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q050_o3_l2.ogg.text: Without it, if the seal breaks, we cannot remake it. Go to the Sect Master. Quickly.

q050_o4_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q050_o4_l0.ogg.text: He fled through the teleport array. Its last destination was the Blood Moon Abyss.

q050_o4_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
