q050_o4_l1.ogg.text: Forty years I trusted him with our law. I trusted him with our children.

q050_o4_l2_f.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q050_o4_l2_f.ogg.text: Rest tonight, Su Yue. Tomorrow we go into the Abyss after him.

q050_o4_l2_m.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q050_o4_l2_m.ogg.text: Rest tonight, Lin Feng. Tomorrow we go into the Abyss after him.

q051_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q051_o0_l0.ogg.text: The Abyss is a wound in the world. A sect army would be seen for a hundred miles. Two disciples might not.

q051_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q051_o0_l1.ogg.text: Find Gu. Find the captives. Do not face the Patriarch's servants alone if you can help it.

q051_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q051_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: And Su Yue... come back. That is not a request.

q051_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q051_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: And Lin Feng... come back. That is not a request.

q051_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q051_o1_l0.ogg.text: You'll need a guide. The Abyss eats people who don't know where to step.

q051_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q051_o1_l2.ogg.text: You shouldn't. But I know the Abyss. I was born to it. I'll show you the way down, and you decide the rest.

q051_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q051_o3_l0.ogg.text: The air is warm and wet, and tastes of copper. Somewhere far below, a drum beats slowly, like a heart.

q052_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q052_o0_l0.ogg.text: Bones crunch underfoot, bleached white under the red moon. Dead trees claw at the sky.

q052_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q052_o0_l1.ogg.text: Walk softly. The sentries listen for the crack of bone.

q052_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q052_o3_l0.ogg.text: You fight well. You hesitate before the killing blow. That will get you killed here.

q052_o3_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q052_o3_l1_f.ogg.text: They were people once, weren't they?

q052_o3_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q052_o3_l1_m.ogg.text: They were people once, weren't they?

q052_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q052_o3_l2.ogg.text: Children stolen from villages. Raised on blood and fear. I was one. The Patriarch took my name when I was six.

q052_o3_l3.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q052_o3_l3.ogg.text: Ye Wuming. It means nameless night. I chose it myself. It is the only thing here I ever chose.

q053_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q053_o2_l0.ogg.text: The lotus hisses in your palm. You draw on the Heart Sutra. Mud, root, blossom. The red fades to a clean, pale pink.

q053_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q053_o3_l0.ogg.text: It tastes like rust and flowers. Thank you.

q053_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q053_o3_l1.ogg.text: I don't trust him. But he hasn't led us into a trap yet. That's either honesty or patience.

q053_o3_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q053_o3_l2_f.ogg.text: Or both. People can be both.

q053_o3_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q053_o3_l2_m.ogg.text: Or both. People can be both.

q054_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q054_o0_l0.ogg.text: Runes crawl across the black stone like beetles. Thin threads of blood run from the obelisks down into the dark.

q054_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q054_o0_l1.ogg.text: They pull the life out of the prisoners and pour it into the altar. Every drop weakens your seal.

q054_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: crimson_xuemei
q054_o1_l0.ogg.text: Little lambs from the Azure Cloud. And one lost puppy, come home at last. Hello, Wuming.

q054_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q054_o1_l1.ogg.text: Xue Mei. Crimson Elder. Stay close to me.

q054_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: crimson_xuemei
q054_o1_l2.ogg.text: I'll take the pretty ice sword for the cages. Kill the rest.

q054_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q054_o2_l0.ogg.text: They took Han Xue. Xue Mei wanted her alive. Her blood is pure. They'll put her in the cages.

q054_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q054_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: Then we go to the cages. Now.

q054_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q054_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: Then we go to the cages. Now.

q054_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q054_o2_l2.ogg.text: Not now. The obelisks will sense you. Break them first, or the cages will drain her before we arrive.

q055_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q055_o1_l0.ogg.text: You press the fragments to the obelisk in Ye Wuming's pattern. Your pendant blazes. The black stone cracks like ice.

q055_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q055_o1_l1.ogg.text: One by one, the obelisks crumble. Far off, in the dark, many voices gasp at once, like people breathing for the first time in days.

q055_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q055_o3_l0.ogg.text: The cages are past the war camp. They'll be expecting us now. Good. Expecting and ready are different things.

q055_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q055_o3_l1.ogg.text: You could have left me at your sect gate. Why didn't you?

q055_o3_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q055_o3_l2_f.ogg.text: Because you've never lied to me. Not once. That's rare.

q055_o3_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q055_o3_l2_m.ogg.text: Because you've never lied to me. Not once. That's rare.

q056_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q056_o0_l0.ogg.text: Crimson banners, black tents, and drums. Hundreds of warriors drill in silent rows.

q056_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q056_o0_l1.ogg.text: The command tent is at the centre. Where there are orders, there are answers.

q056_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q056_o3_l0.ogg.text: This one is orders. A siege on Qingshi Town, with Iron-Fang's bandits, before the next blood moon.

q056_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q056_o3_l1.ogg.text: This one is in Gu's hand. To the Patriarch. The diagram is delivered. Remember your promise. Remember Lan.

q056_o3_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q056_o3_l2_f.ogg.text: Lan? Gu Lan was his daughter. She died twenty years ago.

q056_o3_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q056_o3_l2_m.ogg.text: Lan? Gu Lan was his daughter. She died twenty years ago.

q056_o3_l3.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q056_o3_l3.ogg.text: The Patriarch makes many promises to grieving fathers. He keeps very few.

q057_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q057_o0_l0.ogg.text: Iron cages hang over a pit, each one crowded with pale, silent people. Somewhere a man is singing a lullaby, badly.

q057_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q057_o0_l1.ogg.text: The guards change at the red hour. That's now. Go.

q057_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q057_o2_l0.ogg.text: About time. I was starting to compose my death poem. It was very good. Nobody will ever hear it.

q057_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q057_o2_l1.ogg.text: Farmers, fishermen, disciples of three sects. A young man with Xiao Man's eyes. And a boy who says his name is Liu Er.

q058_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: xiao_shi
q058_o0_l0.ogg.text: You're from the sect? My sister... is Xiao Man all right? Is she eating? She forgets to eat.

q058_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: xiao_shi
q058_o0_l1.ogg.text: I followed the lanterns from the river. They caught me at the graves. They've been bleeding us for weeks.

q058_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: xiao_shi
q058_o0_l2.ogg.text: An elder from our sect was here. Gu. He stood by the altar and talked to the blood like it was a person.

q058_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q058_o2_l0.ogg.text: I'll lead them out. Ye Wuming marked the path. You two go to the altar.

q058_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q058_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: And Su Yue? If Gu is there... don't hesitate. He won't.

q058_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q058_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: And Lin Feng? If Gu is there... don't hesitate. He won't.

q058_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q058_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Get them home safe, Senior Sister. We'll be right behind you.

q058_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q058_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Get them home safe, Senior Sister. We'll be right behind you.

q059_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: crimson_xuemei
q059_o1_l0.ogg.text: You broke my obelisks and stole my lambs. I'll wear your skin to the Patriarch's awakening.

q059_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q059_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: You'll have to catch me first.

q059_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q059_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: You'll have to catch me first.

q059_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: crimson_xuemei
q059_o1_l2.ogg.text: Oh, I love it when they run.

q059_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q059_o2_l0.ogg.text: You drive the Lotus Key against the altar. Green light floods the channels of blood, and the ritual chokes and dies.

q059_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q059_o2_l1.ogg.text: Far below, something vast roars in frustration. The whole abyss shudders.

q059_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q059_o2_l2.ogg.text: Gu is gone. Fled deeper. But you've bought the seal time. Months, maybe.

q060_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q060_o0_l0.ogg.text: These three surrendered. Children, really. Blood Moon trained. The sect would execute them.

q060_o0_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q060_o0_l1_f.ogg.text: They were stolen, like you. Take them. Teach them their own names.

q060_o0_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q060_o0_l1_m.ogg.text: They were stolen, like you. Take them. Teach them their own names.

q060_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q060_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: ...You are a strange cultivator, Su Yue. Very well. I will try.

q060_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q060_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: ...You are a strange cultivator, Lin Feng. Very well. I will try.

q060_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q060_o1_l0.ogg.text: Killing intent presses from every side. Your foundation cracks, and from the crack rises light.

q060_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q060_o1_l1.ogg.text: Your qi spins, tightens, and condenses into a golden core, bright as a small sun in the dark of the abyss.

q060_o1_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q060_o1_l2_f.ogg.text: The darkness can't touch it. I can feel it burning.

q060_o1_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q060_o1_l2_m.ogg.text: The darkness can't touch it. I can feel it burning.

q060_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q060_o2_l0.ogg.text: Brother! Brother, you idiot, you absolute idiot, you never wrote!

q060_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: xiao_shi
q060_o2_l1.ogg.text: There were no brushes in the cage, Man Man.

q060_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q060_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Su Yue, I... thank you. I'll pick herbs for you for a hundred years. I'll only drop some of them.

q060_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q060_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Lin Feng, I... thank you. I'll pick herbs for you for a hundred years. I'll only drop some of them.

q060_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q060_o3_l0.ogg.text: A golden core, the captives freed, and the ritual broken. You went down a disciple and came back a pillar.

q060_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q060_o3_l1.ogg.text: But Qingshi is next. If the letters are true, the Blood Moon marches before the next blood moon.

q060_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q060_o3_l2.ogg.text: Rest one night. Then we defend the town. We will not let it bleed a second time.

q061_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q061_o0_l0.ogg.text: Take Zhao Kang and Wei Tong. The sect must hold the mountain in case this is a feint, so you three are the vanguard.

q061_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q061_o0_l1.ogg.text: Hold Qingshi until the moon wanes. Whatever it costs, don't let them turn the town into another graveyard.

q061_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: magistrate_zhou
q061_o2_l0.ogg.text: The immortals! Good. I have forty guards, three hundred farmers and one very old ballista.

q061_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: magistrate_zhou
q061_o2_l1.ogg.text: I was a coward once, and a monster fed on my town while I drank his tea. Not twice. Tell me where to stand.

q061_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q061_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Right here, Magistrate. People need to see you standing.

q061_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q061_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Right here, Magistrate. People need to see you standing.

q062_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: constable_du
q062_o0_l0.ogg.text: The gate will hold for an hour against cultivators. Maybe. Fire will buy us more. We need oil for the wall braziers.

q062_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: constable_du
q062_o0_l1.ogg.text: Jin's warehouse has barrels of it. He says it's for export. I say it's for not dying.

q062_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: merchant_jin
q062_o1_l0.ogg.text: My oil? That's six months' profit! Who compensates me? The yamen? The yamen owes me for the ballista!

q062_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q062_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: You sold blood lotus to the people who took eleven of your neighbours. You owe this town more than oil.

q062_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q062_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: You sold blood lotus to the people who took eleven of your neighbours. You owe this town more than oil.

q062_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: merchant_jin
q062_o1_l2.ogg.text: ...That was business. I didn't know. I didn't want to know.

q062_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: merchant_jin
q062_o1_l3.ogg.text: Take it. Take all of it. Maybe it will weigh a little less on the scales in the next life.

q062_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q062_o3_l0.ogg.text: You paint the gate posts with cinnabar wards. Constable Du watches, then quietly paints a few crooked ones of his own.

q063_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q063_o0_l0.ogg.text: Torches, thousands of them, flow over the far hills like a burning river. Blood Moon banners, and bandit flags beside them.

q063_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q063_o0_l1.ogg.text: That's... a lot of torches. I'm going to need a bigger lunch.

q063_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q063_o1_l0.ogg.text: The bell rings. Doors slam. Children are carried to the temple. Old men pick up hoes and stand in the street.

q063_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q063_o2_l0.ogg.text: I'll hold the east wall. Wei Tong takes the south. You go wherever it's worst. That's what you're good at.

q063_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q063_o2_l1.ogg.text: And if I die, tell my clan I died beautifully. Specify beautifully.

q063_o2_l3.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q063_o2_l3.ogg.text: Hmph. From your lips to heaven's ears.

q064_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: ferryman_pan
q064_o0_l0.ogg.text: Ferry the farmers across? At night, with bandits shooting at us? Double fare.

q064_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: ferryman_pan
q064_o0_l1.ogg.text: I'm joking. No fare. Forty years on this river, and the first time anyone needed me. Go, I'll bring them over.

q064_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q064_o1_l0.ogg.text: Burn the rice! Burn the barns! Nobody eats this winter unless Iron-Fang says so!

q064_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q064_o2_l0.ogg.text: The farmers are across? Good. I've been guarding the kitchens. Strategically. Armies march on their stomachs.

q064_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q064_o2_l1.ogg.text: Here, a dumpling. Eat it. Then go and hit something. Elder Mo would want you fed and angry.

q065_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q065_o2_l0.ogg.text: You press your palm to the rune circle. The Heart Sutra flows from your golden core, and the blood-ink fades to grey dust.

q065_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q065_o3_l0.ogg.text: The east wall held. Barely. I may have set my own sleeve on fire. It was a tactical fire.

q065_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q065_o3_l1.ogg.text: They didn't push the graveyard to take the town. They wanted blood on those runes. Why?

q066_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q066_o0_l0.ogg.text: Black rafts slide down the river under the red moon. Out on the water, Old Pan's ferry is still crossing, packed with farmers.

q066_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: widow_liu
q066_o3_l0.ogg.text: My Liu Er came home three days ago. Thin as a reed, but home. He talks about a sect disciple who broke his cage.

q066_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: widow_liu
q066_o3_l1.ogg.text: You didn't promise. You just did it. Now I'll carry water to your wall until my arms fall off.

q066_o3_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q066_o3_l2_f.ogg.text: Tell Liu Er to stay inside tonight. And give him an extra bowl of rice from me.

q066_o3_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q066_o3_l2_m.ogg.text: Tell Liu Er to stay inside tonight. And give him an extra bowl of rice from me.

q067_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: merchant_jin
q067_o0_l0.ogg.text: Don't kill me! I dug that tunnel years ago for smuggling tea! Iron-Fang found out. He threatened my daughters.

q067_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: merchant_jin
q067_o0_l1.ogg.text: I opened it for him tonight. Then I saw you give away my oil to people who'd spat at me. I couldn't...

q067_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: merchant_jin
q067_o0_l2.ogg.text: Turn me in. I deserve it. But close the tunnel first. Please.

q067_o0_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q067_o0_l3_f.ogg.text: Fear made you do it. What you do next is your choice. Go help Constable Du, Master Jin.

q067_o0_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q067_o0_l3_m.ogg.text: Fear made you do it. What you do next is your choice. Go help Constable Du, Master Jin.

q067_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q067_o2_l0.ogg.text: A talisman flares. The earth groans, and the tunnel folds in on itself with a satisfying thump.

q068_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q068_o1_l0.ogg.text: You again! The sect brat who took my token. I've dreamed about this, you know. Every night.

q068_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q068_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: I've heard your men talk, Iron-Fang. The Blood Moon holds their families. Holds yours too.

q068_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q068_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: I've heard your men talk, Iron-Fang. The Blood Moon holds their families. Holds yours too.

q068_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q068_o1_l2.ogg.text: Shut up! Shut up and fight!

q068_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q068_o2_l0.ogg.text: Go on, then. Finish it. That's what you sect types do to trash like me.

q068_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q068_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: Where are your people's families, Tie Hu?

q068_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q068_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: Where are your people's families, Tie Hu?

q068_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q068_o2_l2.ogg.text: In the Abyss. Behind the black gate. I burned villages so they'd keep breathing. Does that make it better? It doesn't.

q068_o2_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q068_o2_l3_f.ogg.text: Kneel at this temple and swear to fight for the town you tried to burn. Then help me bring your families home.

q068_o2_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q068_o2_l3_m.ogg.text: Kneel at this temple and swear to fight for the town you tried to burn. Then help me bring your families home.

q068_o2_l4.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q068_o2_l4.ogg.text: ...You're a fool. Fine. Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

q069_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: constable_du
q069_o0_l0.ogg.text: They're at the gate! Everyone with a spear, with me! For Qingshi!

q069_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q069_o1_l0.ogg.text: Well fought, disciple. Truly. You were always the most stubborn of the new ones.

q069_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q069_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: Why, Elder Gu? Why betray the sect? Why feed children to the Blood Moon?

q069_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q069_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: Why, Elder Gu? Why betray the sect? Why feed children to the Blood Moon?

q069_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q069_o1_l2.ogg.text: The Patriarch holds my daughter's soul. When the seal breaks, he will give her back. A new body. A new life.

q069_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q069_o1_l3.ogg.text: This siege was never about the town. Every drop spilled here soaks down to the seal. You've helped him, you know.

q069_o1_l4.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q069_o1_l4.ogg.text: You would do the same for someone you loved. Don't pretend you wouldn't.

q069_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q069_o2_l0.ogg.text: Where Gu stood there is only a scorched talisman and the smell of blood. He is gone.

q069_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q069_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: No. I wouldn't. Not like this.

q069_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q069_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: No. I wouldn't. Not like this.

q070_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: magistrate_zhou
q070_o0_l0.ogg.text: Qingshi stands. Nineteen dead, which is nineteen too many and ten thousand too few for what they intended.

q070_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: magistrate_zhou
q070_o0_l1.ogg.text: I'm having a stele carved at the gate. Your name will be on it. The yamen will not forget. I will not forget.

q070_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: innkeeper_fang
q070_o1_l0.ogg.text: Free wine for the heroes! One cup each. Immortals drink like fish and I'm not a lake.

q070_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: innkeeper_fang
q070_o1_l1.ogg.text: Iron-Fang is washing dishes in my kitchen, by the way. He's surprisingly good. Very thorough scrubber.

q070_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q070_o2_l0.ogg.text: Nineteen tablets. Farmers, a guard, a boy who carried arrows. You burn incense for each, and say each name aloud.

q070_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q070_o3_l0.ogg.text: You held the town. But Gu was right about one thing: the blood reached the seal. It has cracked again.

q070_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q070_o3_l1.ogg.text: We cannot patch it any longer. We must build a new one. The Great Azure Formation, a seal for ten thousand years.

q070_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q070_o3_l2.ogg.text: It needs star iron, thunder crystal and phoenix feathers. They exist in one place: the Celestial Sky Isles.

q071_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q071_o0_l0.ogg.text: Elder Bai has rebuilt the formation design from the Law Hall archive copy. Elder Mo will build it. You will supply it.

q071_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q071_o0_l1.ogg.text: Five star iron, five thunder crystals, three phoenix feathers. The isles close again at the next full moon.

q071_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q071_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: Take Han Xue and Zhao Kang. And Su Yue? Look at the sky while you're up there. It's good for the soul.

q071_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q071_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: Take Han Xue and Zhao Kang. And Lin Feng? Look at the sky while you're up there. It's good for the soul.

q071_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q071_o2_l0.ogg.text: Visitors. Sixty years, and they still come puffing up the stairs like it's a surprise.

q071_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q071_o2_l1.ogg.text: I am Qing Luan. I was a sage of these isles, once. Now I'm mostly a very persistent memory.

q071_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q071_o2_l2.ogg.text: The isles test those who cross. Your heart must be clear, your sword sharp, and your shoes sturdy.

q071_o2_l3.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q071_o2_l3.ogg.text: Two out of three is usually fine. Go on, lotus child. I'll be in my pavilion, watching.

q072_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q072_o0_l0.ogg.text: It's very high. Isn't it very high? Why is there no railing? Who builds a bridge with no railing?

q072_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q072_o0_l1.ogg.text: Immortals who can fly, Zhao Kang.

q072_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q072_o1_l0.ogg.text: Blood Moon! They followed us through the array. Gu must have told them where we were going.

q072_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q072_o2_l0.ogg.text: Why follow us here? What do demons want with the materials for a sealing formation?

q072_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q072_o2_l2.ogg.text: Then why did they only watch us, and not attack until we reached the bridge? Something is wrong. I don't know what yet.

q073_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q073_o1_l0.ogg.text: The wind has no shape, and so nothing can break it. It bends around every obstacle and arrives anyway.

q073_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q073_o2_l0.ogg.text: I've been thinking. It happens occasionally. I've been an insufferable brat to you for two years.

q073_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q073_o2_l1.ogg.text: My brother would have liked you. He always said pride is a wall you build to keep yourself small.

q073_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q073_o2_l2.ogg.text: So. I'm sorry. There. Never tell anyone. I'll deny it with my last breath.

q074_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q074_o0_l0.ogg.text: A riddle! I've waited sixty years to ask someone. What climbs higher the more you take away?

q074_o0_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q074_o0_l1_f.ogg.text: A hole? No... a debt? Wait. A cultivator. The more attachments we let go, the higher we rise.

q074_o0_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q074_o0_l1_m.ogg.text: A hole? No... a debt? Wait. A cultivator. The more attachments we let go, the higher we rise.

q074_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q074_o0_l2.ogg.text: Wrong, but I like your answer better than mine. It was a staircase with the bottom steps removed. Read my chart.

q074_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q074_o1_l0.ogg.text: Constellations drift across the jade. The star iron fell with the palace. The thunder grows where the vein runs.

q074_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q074_o1_l1.ogg.text: In the chart's corner, a seven-star pattern glows red. It is labelled: the Patriarch's Ladder.

q074_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q074_o2_l0.ogg.text: Three hundred years ago a man called Xue Wuji came here. Very charming. He wanted the Ascension Stair.

q074_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q074_o2_l1.ogg.text: He meant to ride the heavenly tribulation into the heavens and take them. Your founders stopped him, barely.

q074_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q074_o2_l2.ogg.text: The star iron lies in the fallen palace. Watch out for the guardians. They're rude.

q075_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q075_o0_l0.ogg.text: Broken columns tower into the clouds. Among them lie lumps of dark metal, still faintly warm from falling out of the sky.

q075_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q075_o3_l0.ogg.text: Whoever climbs the stair must carry nothing that is not theirs. Not a stolen body. Not a stolen name. Not a stolen heaven.

q075_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q075_o3_l1.ogg.text: Stolen body? What kind of warning is that?

q076_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q076_o0_l0.ogg.text: Blood Guards, with picks and sacks. They're mining thunder crystals!

q076_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q076_o2_l0.ogg.text: Crates of thunder crystals, carefully packed, each stamped with the same seven-star mark as the red stars.

q076_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q076_o2_l1.ogg.text: Thunder crystals are only good for one thing: channelling heavenly lightning into a formation.

q076_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q076_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Our formation needs them too. Why would the Blood Moon build the same thing we're building?

q076_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q076_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Our formation needs them too. Why would the Blood Moon build the same thing we're building?

q077_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q077_o0_l0.ogg.text: Blossom trees taller than pagodas. Petals fall like warm snow. High in the branches, something golden rustles its wings.

q077_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q077_o2_l0.ogg.text: You have the feathers. Good. Now you have a problem. The Jiao smelled them. It smells everything.

q077_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q077_o2_l1.ogg.text: It was a noble beast, guardian of these isles for a thousand years. Then the Blood Moon fed it their blood.

q077_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q077_o2_l2.ogg.text: It is suffering. It will kill you because it is suffering. Please free it.

q078_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q078_o0_l0.ogg.text: The isle shudders. Scales the colour of storm clouds slide past, and a head the size of a house rises over the edge.

q078_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q078_o0_l1.ogg.text: Nobody told me the serpent was THAT big.

q078_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q078_o1_l0.ogg.text: Its heart is still in there, lotus child. Strike the blood from it, not the life!

q078_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q078_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: I hear you. Hold on, great one. I'll set you free.

q078_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q078_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: I hear you. Hold on, great one. I'll set you free.

q078_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q078_o2_l0.ogg.text: It looked at you before it sank into the clouds. Not like a beast. Like someone saying thank you.

q078_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q078_o2_l1.ogg.text: You're shaking. Sit. That's an order from your senior sister, and I rarely give them.

q079_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q079_o0_l0.ogg.text: Among bones and coins lies a heart of star iron the size of a fist, humming with stored lightning.

q079_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q079_o0_l1.ogg.text: Its weight settles into your hands like it has been waiting for you.

q079_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q079_o1_l0.ogg.text: Star iron, thunder crystal, phoenix feather, and a dragon heart. We're rich. We're heroes. We're rich heroes.

q079_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q079_o1_l1.ogg.text: Come on. Wei Tong promised a banquet. I'm told he's been practising dumplings for a month.

q079_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q079_o2_l0.ogg.text: Show me the design your sect intends to build. Hm. Hmm. The stars disagree with it.

q079_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q079_o2_l1.ogg.text: Here, where it should turn inward, it turns outward. As if it were meant to open rather than close.

q079_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q079_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: It was rebuilt from the sect's Law Hall archive.

q079_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q079_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: It was rebuilt from the sect's Law Hall archive.

q079_o2_l3.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q079_o2_l3.ogg.text: Then ask who kept the archive. Go carefully, lotus child. Heaven is watching you now.

q080_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q080_o0_l0.ogg.text: Your golden core cracks, and from it unfolds a tiny figure of light, cross-legged, with your face and a lotus in its hands.

q080_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q080_o0_l1.ogg.text: It opens its eyes. For the first time, you see the world twice: with your eyes, and with your soul.

q080_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q080_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: Nascent Soul. Even the clouds look different. They look like they're breathing.

q080_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q080_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: Nascent Soul. Even the clouds look different. They look like they're breathing.

q080_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q080_o1_l0.ogg.text: Star iron. Thunder crystal. Phoenix feathers. And a dragon's heart, you show-off. The formation will be finished in a week.

q080_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q080_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: Elder, the star-gazer said the design is wrong. That it opens instead of closing. It was taken from the Law Hall archive.

q080_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q080_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: Elder, the star-gazer said the design is wrong. That it opens instead of closing. It was taken from the Law Hall archive.

q080_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q080_o1_l2.ogg.text: Bai checked it against the archive copy, sealed and certified. The Law Hall... hm. Gu kept that archive for thirty years.

q080_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q080_o1_l3.ogg.text: Leave it with me. I'll check every rune myself. Go, see the Sect Master. You've earned your cake.

q080_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q080_o2_l0.ogg.text: A nascent soul at your age. The elders are furious with envy. It's wonderful.

q080_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q080_o2_l1.ogg.text: Elder Mo told me about the design. He is checking it himself. If anyone can find a hidden flaw, it is him.

q080_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q080_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Rest, Su Yue. For the first time in months, I think the sect can breathe.

q080_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q080_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Rest, Lin Feng. For the first time in months, I think the sect can breathe.

q081_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q081_o1_l0.ogg.text: Ten thousand runes glow a calm blue. Only in the outer ring, one branch seems to twist, like a signature written backwards.

q081_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q081_o2_l0.ogg.text: Three nights, ten thousand runes. My eyes feel like two boiled dumplings. Don't tell Wei Tong I said that.

q081_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q081_o2_l1.ogg.text: I found something. A turn in the outer ring that shouldn't be there. I need one more night to be certain.

q081_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q081_o2_l2.ogg.text: Here. My old sword tassel. My master gave it to me when I formed my core. It's yours now.

q081_o2_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q081_o2_l3_f.ogg.text: Elder, why give it to me now?

q081_o2_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q081_o2_l3_m.ogg.text: Elder, why give it to me now?

q081_o2_l4_f.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q081_o2_l4_f.ogg.text: Because I'm old, and I forget things. Better to give it too early than too late. Go on, Junior Sister.

q081_o2_l4_m.ogg.speaker: elder_mo
q081_o2_l4_m.ogg.text: Because I'm old, and I forget things. Better to give it too early than too late. Go on, Junior Brother.

q081_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q081_o3_l0.ogg.text: You're back! You're taller. Are you taller? Nascent Soul makes people taller, I read it somewhere. Maybe.

q081_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q081_o3_l1.ogg.text: Elder Mo's been in a strange mood. Keeps patting my shoulder. He gave me his tea set. His good tea set.

q081_o3_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q081_o3_l2.ogg.text: Old men do that before long journeys. He's not going anywhere, is he?

q082_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q082_o0_l0.ogg.text: A crow brought this. A crow! It bit me. Twice. It had opinions.

q082_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q082_o0_l1.ogg.text: It's addressed to you. The seal is the Law Hall's. I thought about burning it. Then I thought, you'd want to know.

q082_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q082_o1_l0.ogg.text: Come to the Heart Mirror, alone. I will tell you how to save your sect. Bring anyone, and I will tell you nothing. Gu Hanshan.

q082_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q082_o2_l0.ogg.text: It's a trap. Obviously. Everything Gu does is a trap wrapped in a lesson.

q082_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q082_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: But if he knows something about the formation... Elder Mo found a flaw. I can't ignore this.

q082_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q082_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: But if he knows something about the formation... Elder Mo found a flaw. I can't ignore this.

q082_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q082_o2_l2.ogg.text: I know. That's what worries me. Go. If you're not back by dawn, I'm telling Elder Mo, and then I'm coming to drag you home.

q083_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q083_o1_l0.ogg.text: You came alone. Good. Then listen, because there is no time. The formation your sect built is a key, not a lock.

q083_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q083_o1_l1.ogg.text: Twenty years ago I altered the archive copy. Seven runes. When it is lit, it will pour the sect's qi into the Abyss and break the seal from above.

q083_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q083_o1_l2.ogg.text: I did it for Lan. The Patriarch swore he held her soul. He did. He fed it to the Heart Mirror long ago. I heard her screaming there.

q083_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q083_o1_l3.ogg.text: I cannot face the mirror. It shows me what I am. You can. Free her. Then run home before they light it.

q083_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q083_o2_l0.ogg.text: A pool of black water, perfectly still. Your reflection looks back at you. Then it smiles, a moment before you do.

q084_o1_l0_f.ogg.speaker: heart_demon
q084_o1_l0_f.ogg.text: You were never chosen, Su Yue. You were only unlucky enough to be born holding the key.

q084_o1_l0_m.ogg.speaker: heart_demon
q084_o1_l0_m.ogg.text: You were never chosen, Lin Feng. You were only unlucky enough to be born holding the key.

q084_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: heart_demon
q084_o1_l1.ogg.text: Everyone you love will die because of that pendant. Mo. Han Xue. That silly girl by the pond. Give it to me.

q084_o1_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q084_o1_l2_f.ogg.text: You're not me. You're only the part of me that's afraid.

q084_o1_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q084_o1_l2_m.ogg.text: You're not me. You're only the part of me that's afraid.

q084_o1_l3.ogg.speaker: heart_demon
q084_o1_l3.ogg.text: Then why are your hands shaking?

q084_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q084_o2_l0.ogg.text: You sit at the water's edge. Your hands stop shaking. The mirror ripples, and light rises from it like fireflies.

q084_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q084_o2_l1.ogg.text: Hundreds of souls, drifting upward. One stops in front of you: a girl with Gu's eyes, who bows once, and is gone.

q084_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q084_o3_l0.ogg.text: I saw her. She bowed to you. She always had better manners than her father.

q084_o3_l1_f.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q084_o3_l1_f.ogg.text: Go. Now. The formation... I can feel it waking even from here. Run, Su Yue, run!

q084_o3_l1_m.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q084_o3_l1_m.ogg.text: Go. Now. The formation... I can feel it waking even from here. Run, Lin Feng, run!

q085_o0_l0_f.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q085_o0_l0_f.ogg.text: Su Yue! The formation lit itself at midnight. Blood Moon disciples came out of nowhere, in our robes!

q085_o0_l0_m.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q085_o0_l0_m.ogg.text: Lin Feng! The formation lit itself at midnight. Blood Moon disciples came out of nowhere, in our robes!

q085_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: gate_lu
q085_o0_l1.ogg.text: Elder Mo went into the array. He told everyone to stay back. The light's gone red. It's gone all red!

q085_o2_l0_f.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q085_o2_l0_f.ogg.text: They're protecting the array! They want it to keep burning. Su Yue, get to Elder Mo!

q085_o2_l0_m.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q085_o2_l0_m.ogg.text: They're protecting the array! They want it to keep burning. Lin Feng, get to Elder Mo!

q086_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q086_o1_l0.ogg.text: He poured his whole life into the array's eye and turned the flow back. Seventy years of cultivation, in one breath.

q086_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q086_o1_l1.ogg.text: The seal holds. The sect lives. And Mo Changfeng is gone.

q086_o1_l2.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q086_o1_l2.ogg.text: He asked me to tell you something. He said, adequate. More than adequate.

q086_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q086_o2_l0.ogg.text: He gave me his tea set. I thought he was being nice. He was saying goodbye, and I didn't even notice.

q086_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q086_o2_l1.ogg.text: I was going to make him dumplings. Proper ones, for his birthday. I've been practising for a month.

q086_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q086_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Make them anyway, Senior Brother. We'll eat them for him.

q086_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q086_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Make them anyway, Senior Brother. We'll eat them for him.

q087_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q087_o0_l0.ogg.text: Nine strokes. Across the mountain, every disciple stops what they are doing and bows toward the hall.

q087_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q087_o1_l0.ogg.text: I've mended a thousand broken bones for that stubborn old man. He never once said thank you.

q087_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_hua
q087_o1_l1.ogg.text: He'd leave peaches on my doorstep instead. Every autumn, for forty years. I'll miss the peaches.

q087_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q087_o2_l0.ogg.text: I brought plum blossoms. Elder Mo pretended he didn't like flowers, but he always smelled them when he thought no one was looking.

q087_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: xiao_man
q087_o2_l1.ogg.text: Are you all right? You don't have to be. My brother says being all right is overrated.

q087_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q087_o3_l0.ogg.text: The sea of clouds, where you first condensed your qi. Elder Mo's tassel flutters in your hand.

q087_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q087_o3_l1.ogg.text: Back straight. A crooked spine makes a crooked meridian. You straighten your back, and weep, and breathe.

q088_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q088_o0_l0.ogg.text: I've read the seven altered runes. The formation would open the Abyss upward, like a stairwell, for one soul to climb.

q088_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q088_o0_l1.ogg.text: The Patriarch cannot survive the heavenly tribulation in his own body. Too much blood, too much sin. Heaven would erase him.

q088_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: elder_bai
q088_o0_l2.ogg.text: He needs a body with a clean dao and the Verdant Lotus in its veins. The mirror was meant to crack your heart so he could step in.

q088_o0_l3_f.ogg.speaker: player
q088_o0_l3_f.ogg.text: He wants to wear me. To ascend in my skin.

q088_o0_l3_m.ogg.speaker: player
q088_o0_l3_m.ogg.text: He wants to wear me. To ascend in my skin.

q088_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q088_o1_l0.ogg.text: Laid beside the Heart Sutra, the seven altered runes are plain as day: a lotus drawn upside down, a door drawn inside out.

q088_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q088_o2_l0.ogg.text: I surrendered at your gate an hour after you left the mirror. The Sect Master says my fate is yours to decide.

q088_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q088_o2_l1.ogg.text: Execute me. It's what the precepts demand. I wrote half of them.

q088_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q088_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: No. Come with us to the Abyss. Fight as an elder of the Azure Cloud. If you must die, die as one.

q088_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q088_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: No. Come with us to the Abyss. Fight as an elder of the Azure Cloud. If you must die, die as one.

q088_o2_l3.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q088_o2_l3.ogg.text: ...Mo would have said the same. Very well. I will show you the way through the black gate.

q089_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q089_o0_l0.ogg.text: The Zhao clan sent me a letter telling me to come home where it's safe. I used it to light incense for Elder Mo.

q089_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q089_o0_l1.ogg.text: I swear on my brother's name, I'll be at your side at the black gate. Try not to steal all the glory.

q089_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: xiao_shi
q089_o1_l0.ogg.text: I can't fight like you. But I know the Abyss. I was there for weeks. I'll draw every path I remember.

q089_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: xiao_shi
q089_o1_l1.ogg.text: Man Man is making medicine bundles. Hundreds of them. She's only dropped a few.

q089_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: steward_qian
q089_o2_l0.ogg.text: The treasury is open. All of it. Take whatever you need. Spirit stones are useless to the dead.

q089_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: steward_qian
q089_o2_l1.ogg.text: I have counted every stone in this sect for thirty years. Tonight I will count nothing. Just come back.

q089_o4_l0.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q089_o4_l0.ogg.text: The blood moon rises in three days. On that night the Patriarch will break free with or without your formation.

q089_o4_l1.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q089_o4_l1.ogg.text: The children you let me take are with me. And Iron-Fang, with his men. We will open the way.

q089_o4_l2_f.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q089_o4_l2_f.ogg.text: I owe you a name, Su Yue. I intend to pay.

q089_o4_l2_m.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q089_o4_l2_m.ogg.text: I owe you a name, Lin Feng. I intend to pay.

q090_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q090_o1_l0.ogg.text: Where Elder Mo gave his life, you sit. The formation rises around you, blue and clean. It feels like being held.

q090_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q090_o1_l1.ogg.text: Your nascent soul grows, merges with your body, and the boundary between you and heaven and earth thins like mist.

q090_o1_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q090_o1_l2_f.ogg.text: Thank you, Elder Mo. I'll carry it from here.

q090_o1_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q090_o1_l2_m.ogg.text: Thank you, Elder Mo. I'll carry it from here.

q090_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q090_o2_l0.ogg.text: Soul Transformation. Heaven itself will notice you now. So will the Patriarch.

q090_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q090_o2_l1.ogg.text: In three days we march on the Abyss, every disciple who can hold a sword. We end this, as our founders could not.

q090_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q090_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Mo believed in you before any of us. Let's prove him right, Su Yue.

q090_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q090_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Mo believed in you before any of us. Let's prove him right, Lin Feng.

q091_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q091_o1_l0.ogg.text: Wei Tong and Zhao Kang break the war camp. Ye Wuming's people take the obelisk ring. Gu will open the black gate.

q091_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q091_o1_l1.ogg.text: You go through the gate, to the throne. I'll be behind you, holding the sect together.

q091_o1_l2_f.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q091_o1_l2_f.ogg.text: Whatever happens, Su Yue, you are not carrying this alone. Remember the letter in the reliquary.

q091_o1_l2_m.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q091_o1_l2_m.ogg.text: Whatever happens, Lin Feng, you are not carrying this alone. Remember the letter in the reliquary.

q091_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q091_o2_l0.ogg.text: My men are ready. Forty bandits, washed and fed, which is a first. They're a bit confused about it.

q091_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q091_o2_l1.ogg.text: Their families are behind that gate. We'll follow you through anything, sect brat. Sorry. Sect hero.

q091_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q091_o3_l0.ogg.text: Stay alive. That's not a request, it's what the Sect Master said, and I'm saying it louder.

q091_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q091_o3_l1.ogg.text: And after, when this is done, you owe me a proper sparring match. No holding back.

q092_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q092_o0_l0.ogg.text: For Elder Mo! Hey, Elder, are you watching? Watch this one!

q092_o1_l0_f.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q092_o1_l0_f.ogg.text: Left side's mine, Su Yue! You can have the right side. It's smaller.

q092_o1_l0_m.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q092_o1_l0_m.ogg.text: Left side's mine, Lin Feng! You can have the right side. It's smaller.

q092_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q092_o2_l0.ogg.text: We did it! The camp's burning, and I've only lost one bun. It was a very brave bun.

q092_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_wei
q092_o2_l1.ogg.text: Go on. The gate's ahead. Elder Mo would've said something grumpy and encouraging. Pretend I did.

q093_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q093_o0_l0.ogg.text: Remember the blood-red token you took from Iron-Fang's chest? The one I confiscated? I kept it.

q093_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q093_o0_l1.ogg.text: It's a command token. With it, the gate guards will let me in. They don't know yet what I have become.

q093_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q093_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: They'll kill you when they find out.

q093_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q093_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: They'll kill you when they find out.

q093_o0_l3.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q093_o0_l3.ogg.text: Yes. I've made my peace with that. It is the first peace I have felt in twenty years.

q093_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q093_o1_l0.ogg.text: The gate is black iron, carved with a moon swallowing a sword. It is taller than the main hall. It is utterly silent.

q093_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q093_o1_l1.ogg.text: Then, from inside, the sound of fighting. One man against many.

q093_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q093_o2_l0.ogg.text: You strike the seal with the Lotus Key. From the other side, someone pulls the great bar. The black gate groans open.

q094_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q094_o1_l0.ogg.text: Ah. You came. I held them... as long as I could. I was always better at law than fighting.

q094_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q094_o1_l1.ogg.text: Tell the sect... tell them the Law Hall is empty now. Fill it with someone kinder than me.

q094_o1_l2_f.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q094_o1_l2_f.ogg.text: Lan... is waiting. I think she'll let me apologise. Thank you, Su Yue.

q094_o1_l2_m.ogg.speaker: elder_gu
q094_o1_l2_m.ogg.text: Lan... is waiting. I think she'll let me apologise. Thank you, Lin Feng.

q094_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q094_o2_l0.ogg.text: The last locks fall. Mothers, children, old men stumble into the red light, blinking, alive.

q094_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q094_o3_l0.ogg.text: They're here. All of them. My sister. My men's wives, their children. Alive.

q094_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: bandit_tie
q094_o3_l1.ogg.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Today, in full. My blade is yours until the Patriarch's head is on the floor.

q095_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q095_o1_l0.ogg.text: The altar cracks from top to bottom. Three hundred years of stolen blood pours out and soaks away into the stone.

q095_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q095_o1_l1.ogg.text: It's done. His power has no root now. Only what he carries in himself.

q095_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q095_o2_l0.ogg.text: In the silence after the altar breaks, you sink inward. Past body, past qi, past soul, to the empty place beneath.

q095_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q095_o2_l1.ogg.text: Nothing is there. And nothing is exactly enough. You rise with the stillness of the void in your bones.

q096_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: patriarch_xue
q096_o2_l0.ogg.text: Come then, little lotus. Show me the body I will wear to heaven.

q096_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q096_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: My body stays mine, Xue Wuji. So does my heart.

q096_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q096_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: My body stays mine, Xue Wuji. So does my heart.

q096_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: patriarch_xue
q096_o2_l2.ogg.text: We shall see how long you hold them both.

q096_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q096_o3_l0.ogg.text: His body is dust. But his remnant soul tore free and fled upward. To the Sky Isles.

q096_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q096_o3_l1.ogg.text: Your breakthrough has drawn heaven's eye. Your tribulation is gathering. He means to steal it, and ascend in your place.

q096_o3_l2_f.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q096_o3_l2_f.ogg.text: I have my name back, Su Yue. The children have theirs. Go. Finish it. We'll hold the abyss.

q096_o3_l2_m.ogg.speaker: wanderer_ye
q096_o3_l2_m.ogg.text: I have my name back, Lin Feng. The children have theirs. Go. Finish it. We'll hold the abyss.

q097_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q097_o0_l0.ogg.text: You're back early. Also, the sky is on fire. I assume those two facts are related.

q097_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q097_o0_l1.ogg.text: A remnant soul crossed my bridge an hour ago. It is climbing toward the tribulation peak, possessing everything it touches.

q097_o0_l2.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q097_o0_l2.ogg.text: Heaven's lightning is gathering for you, lotus child. Get to the peak before he does.

q097_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q097_o2_l0.ogg.text: I followed you through the array. Obviously. Did you think I'd let you face the sky alone?

q097_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q097_o2_l1.ogg.text: I'll hold the bridge. Nothing else crosses. Go.

q097_o2_l2_f.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q097_o2_l2_f.ogg.text: Su Yue... you still owe me that sparring match. Don't you dare ascend without paying your debts.

q097_o2_l2_m.ogg.speaker: senior_han
q097_o2_l2_m.ogg.text: Lin Feng... you still owe me that sparring match. Don't you dare ascend without paying your debts.

q098_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q098_o2_l0.ogg.text: The crystals drink from the vein until they hum. Planted on the summit, they will split heaven's lightning like a river delta.

q098_o3_l0.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q098_o3_l0.ogg.text: Don't look at me like that. Of course I came. Someone has to witness your triumph and complain about it.

q098_o3_l1.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q098_o3_l1.ogg.text: Swear something to me. When you come back down, we fight. Properly. And I win.

q098_o3_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q098_o3_l2_f.ogg.text: When I come back down, Zhao Kang. And you'll lose.

q098_o3_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q098_o3_l2_m.ogg.text: When I come back down, Zhao Kang. And you'll lose.

q098_o3_l3.ogg.speaker: rival_zhao
q098_o3_l3.ogg.text: Ha! That's the spirit. Go. The sky is waiting, and it has terrible manners.

q099_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: patriarch_xue
q099_o1_l0.ogg.text: The ninth bolt is the heart tribulation. I will be your heart, little lotus.

q099_o1_l1_f.ogg.speaker: heart_demon
q099_o1_l1_f.ogg.text: Hello again, Su Yue. He found me in the mirror. He says we can share.

q099_o1_l1_m.ogg.speaker: heart_demon
q099_o1_l1_m.ogg.text: Hello again, Lin Feng. He found me in the mirror. He says we can share.

q099_o1_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q099_o1_l2_f.ogg.text: I beat you once. I'll do it as often as it takes.

q099_o1_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q099_o1_l2_m.ogg.text: I beat you once. I'll do it as often as it takes.

q099_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q099_o2_l0.ogg.text: The lightning comes. First, second, third. Your body breaks and remakes itself. Fourth, fifth, sixth. Your qi burns white.

q099_o2_l1.ogg.speaker: narrator
q099_o2_l1.ogg.text: Seventh, eighth. The remnant screams as the lightning finds it, and there is nothing left of Xue Wuji but ash on the wind.

q099_o2_l2.ogg.speaker: narrator
q099_o2_l2.ogg.text: The ninth bolt strikes, and it does not hurt at all. It feels like the sky, saying your name.

q100_o0_l0.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q100_o0_l0.ogg.text: The stair has opened for you. Three hundred years, and our sect has its first immortal.

q100_o0_l1.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q100_o0_l1.ogg.text: You don't have to go. The heavens will wait. They have nothing but time.

q100_o0_l2_f.ogg.speaker: player
q100_o0_l2_f.ogg.text: If I stay, the stair closes, and nobody climbs it again for a thousand years. Someone should see what's up there.

q100_o0_l2_m.ogg.speaker: player
q100_o0_l2_m.ogg.text: If I stay, the stair closes, and nobody climbs it again for a thousand years. Someone should see what's up there.

q100_o0_l3_f.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q100_o0_l3_f.ogg.text: Then go, Su Yue. And look down on us sometimes. We'll be the ones waving.

q100_o0_l3_m.ogg.speaker: master_yun
q100_o0_l3_m.ogg.text: Then go, Lin Feng. And look down on us sometimes. We'll be the ones waving.

q100_o1_l0.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q100_o1_l0.ogg.text: Sixty years I waited here for someone worth the climb. It was worth it. Don't tell anyone I said so.

q100_o1_l1.ogg.speaker: star_sage
q100_o1_l1.ogg.text: At the top, you'll find a door. Knock politely. Heaven is very sensitive about manners.

q100_o2_l0.ogg.speaker: narrator
q100_o2_l0.ogg.text: Each step is made of light. Below, your friends grow small. Han Xue raises her sword in salute. Zhao Kang pretends not to cry.

q100_o2_l1_f.ogg.speaker: player
q100_o2_l1_f.ogg.text: Elder Mo. Mother. Everyone. Thank you.

q100_o2_l1_m.ogg.speaker: player
q100_o2_l1_m.ogg.text: Elder Mo. Mother. Everyone. Thank you.
